The aggregated <see cref=\"GuardrailRunResult\"/> tells the attempt loop\n/// whether any failed and whether a timeout was involved.\n/// </summary>\ninternal sealed class GuardrailRunner\n{\n    private readonly PlanDefinition _plan;\n    private readonly IRunObserver _observer;\n    private readonly ScriptUnitRunner _scriptRunner;\n    private readonly PromptExecutionSupport _promptSupport;\n    private readonly Func<TaskNode, int?, TimeSpan> _resolveTimeout;\n\n    public GuardrailRunner(\n        PlanDefinition plan,\n        IRunObserver observer,\n        ScriptUnitRunner scriptRunner,\n        PromptExecutionSupport promptSupport,\n        Func<TaskNode, int?, TimeSpan> resolveTimeout)\n    {\n        _plan = plan;\n        _observer = observer;\n        _scriptRunner = scriptRunner;\n        _promptSupport = promptSupport;\n        _resolveTimeout = resolveTimeout;\n    }\n\n    public async Task<GuardrailRunResult> RunAsync(\n        TaskNode task,\n        string workspace,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> env,\n        string snapshotPath,\n        string logDir,\n        CancellationToken cancellationToken,\n        string? worktreeRoot = null)\n    {\n        var results = new List<GuardrailResult>(task.Guardrails.Count);\n        bool anyFailed = false;\n        bool timedOut = false;\n\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition guardrail in task.Guardrails)\n        {\n            (GuardrailResult result, bool guardrailTimedOut) = guardrail.Kind == ActionKind.Prompt\n                ? await RunPromptGuardrailAsync(task, guardrail, workspace, env, snapshotPath, logDir, cancellationToken, worktreeRoot).ConfigureAwait(false)\n                : await RunScriptGuardrailAsync(task, guardrail, workspace, env, logDir, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);\n\n            results.Add(result);\n            _observer.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)\n            {\n                break; // the caller turns this into a cancelled attempt\n            }\n\n            if (!result.Passed)\n            {\n                anyFailed = true;\n                timedOut |= guardrailTimedOut;\n                if (_plan.Config.GuardrailMode == GuardrailMode.FailFast)\n                {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return new GuardrailRunResult { Results = results, AnyFailed = anyFailed, TimedOut = timedOut };\n    }\n\n    private async Task<(GuardrailResult Result, bool TimedOut)> RunScriptGuardrailAsync(\n        TaskNode task,\n        GuardrailDefinition guardrail,\n        string workspace,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> env,\n        string logDir,\n        CancellationToken cancellationToken)\n    {\n        ProcessResult processResult = await _scriptRunner.RunAsync(\n            guardrail.Path, guardrail.Args, workspace, env,\n            _resolveTimeout(task, guardrail.TimeoutSeconds), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);\n\n        AttemptArtifacts.WriteGuardrailLogs(logDir, guardrail.Name, processResult);\n        return (ToGuardrailResult(guardrail, processResult), processResult.TimedOut);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Run a PROMPT guardrail (SSOT §4.2/§9): compose the verifier prompt, set\n    /// <c>GUARDRAILS_VERDICT_OUT</c>, invoke the runner (guardrail-overrides profile), then\n    /// judge pass/fail SOLELY by the verdict file — never the runner's exit code. Missing or\n    /// invalid verdict ⇒ fail with the contractual reason.\n    /// </summary>\n    private async Task<(GuardrailResult Result, bool TimedOut)> RunPromptGuardrailAsync(\n        TaskNode task,\n        GuardrailDefinition guardrail,\n        string workspace,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> env,\n        string snapshotPath,\n        string logDir,\n        CancellationToken cancellationToken,\n        string? worktreeRoot)\n    {\n        PromptRunnerRegistry registry = _promptSupport.RequireRegistry();\n        PromptFile promptFile = PromptExecutionSupport.LoadPromptFile(guardrail.Path);\n        PromptRunnerConfig runnerConfig = registry.ResolveConfig(promptFile.Frontmatter.Runner);\n\n        string verdictPath = Path.Combine(logDir, $\"guardrail-{Sanitize(guardrail.Name)}.verdict.json\");\n        string actionStdoutPath = env.TryGetValue(\"GUARDRAILS_ACTION_STDOUT\", out string? stdoutPath)\n            ? stdoutPath\n            : Path.Combine(logDir, \"action-stdout.log\");\n\n        bool isWorktreeMode = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(worktreeRoot);\n        string composed = PromptComposer.ComposeGuardrail(promptFile.Body, snapshotPath, verdictPath, actionStdoutPath, isWorktreeMode);\n        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(logDir, $\"composed-prompt.{Sanitize(guardrail.Name)}.md\"), composed);\n\n        var guardrailEnv = new Dictionary<string, string>(env, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n        {\n            [\"GUARDRAILS_VERDICT_OUT\"] = verdictPath\n        };\n\n        PromptRunnerSettings settings = PromptExecutionSupport.ApplyPromptOverrides(\n            runnerConfig.EffectiveSettings(isGuardrail: true),\n            promptFile.Frontmatter.MaxTurns);\n\n        // Worktree containment hook (issue #199/#192) for a prompt GUARDRAIL: same OUTER boundary as\n        // a prompt action — a verifier prompt is still an agent that can Write/Edit/Bash.\n        if (isWorktreeMode)\n        {\n            string guardrailSettingsPath = WorktreeContainmentHook.WriteHookFiles(\n                logDir, worktreeRoot!, $\"guardrail-{Sanitize(guardrail.Name)}\");\n            settings = settings with { ExtraArgs = [.. settings.ExtraArgs, \"--settings\", guardrailSettingsPath] };\n        }\n\n        var invocation = new PromptInvocation\n        {\n            ComposedPrompt = composed,\n            WorkingDirectory = workspace,\n            PlanDirectory = _plan.PlanDirectory,\n            Environment = guardrailEnv,\n            Settings = settings,\n            Timeout = _resolveTimeout(task, guardrail.TimeoutSeconds ?? promptFile.Frontmatter.TimeoutSeconds),\n            StreamLogPath = Path.Combine(logDir, $\"guardrail-{Sanitize(guardrail.Name)}.stream.jsonl\"),\n            TranscriptLogPath = Path.Combine(logDir, $\"guardrail-{Sanitize(guardrail.Name)}.transcript.md\")\n        };\n\n        PromptResult promptResult = await registry.Resolve(promptFile.Frontmatter.Runner)\n            .RunAsync(invocation, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);\n\n        // Pass/fail is the verdict file, full stop (NEVER the exit code).\n        GuardrailVerdict verdict = GuardrailVerdictReader.Read(verdictPath);\n        string reason = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(verdict.Reason)\n            ? (verdict.Pass ? \"passed\" : GuardrailVerdictReader.NoValidVerdictReason)\n            : verdict.Reason;\n\n        var result = new GuardrailResult\n        {\n            Name = guardrail.Name,\n            Passed = verdict.Pass,\n            Reason = verdict.Pass ? null : reason\n        };\n\n        // The prompt guardrail's stdout/stderr are not the verdict, but tee them for audit\n        // (the runner already teed its stream; capture nothing more here). Timeouts surface\n        // as \"did not complete\" → no verdict → fail, which the reader already handled.\n        return (result, !promptResult.Completed && promptResult.Summary.Contains(\"timed out\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n    }\n\n    private static GuardrailResult ToGuardrailResult(GuardrailDefinition guardrail, ProcessResult result)\n    {\n        if (result.Succeeded)\n        {\n            return new GuardrailResult { Name = guardrail.Name, Passed = true };\n        }\n\n        string reason = result.TimedOut\n            ? \"guardrail timed out\"\n            : FirstNonEmptyLine(result.StandardOutput)\n              ?? FirstNonEmptyLine(result.StandardError)\n              ?? $\"exit code {result.ExitCode}\";\n\n        // The one-line reason feeds the UI/journal; the FULL output feeds retry feedback\n        // (issue #26 Gap 1) so a multi-error failure surfaces every error, not just the first.\n        string? output = FirstNonEmptyLine(result.StandardOutput) is not null\n            ? result.StandardOutput\n            : (FirstNonEmptyLine(result.StandardError) is not null ? result.StandardError : null);\n\n        return new GuardrailResult { Name = guardrail.Name, Passed = false, Reason = reason, Output = output };\n    }\n\n    private static string? FirstNonEmptyLine(string text)\n    {\n        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))\n        {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        foreach (string line in text.Split('\\n'))\n        {\n            string trimmed = line.Trim();\n            if (trimmed.Length > 0)\n            {\n                return trimmed;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private static string Sanitize(string name)\n    {\n        Span<char> buffer = stackalloc char[name.Length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < name.Length; i++)\n        {\n            char c = name[i];\n            buffer[i] = char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_' or '.' ? c : '_';\n        }\n\n        return new string(buffer);\n    }\n}\n\n/// <summary>The outcome of a single attempt's guardrail pass.</summary>\ninternal sealed record GuardrailRunResult\n{\n    public required IReadOnlyList<GuardrailResult> Results { get; init; }\n    public required bool AnyFailed { get; init; }\n    public required bool TimedOut { get; init; }\n}\n","numLines":235,"startLine":1,"totalLines":235}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013tvLWyS76Vsmr3TDtnrmZ5","type":"tool_result","content":"205\t    ///   <item>GitHub renders Mermaid in a sandboxed mode that disables clicks, so these would be\n206\t    ///         inert in <c>diagram.md</c> — and the targets are <c>file://</c>-local anyway.</item>\n207\t    ///   <item>They are deliberately NOT in <c>diagram.md</c> and NOT in the staleness hash\n208\t    ///         (<see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>); the targets are derived deterministically from the\n209\t    ///         same plan, as plan-relative forward-slash paths, so the output is byte-identical on\n210\t    ///         every OS (no timestamp, no absolute path).</item>\n211\t    /// </list>\n212\t    /// A TASK CONTAINER's click target is NOT a Mermaid <c>click</c> directive at all (see class\n213\t    /// remarks, \"A task container's click target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\" — issue\n214\t    /// #232/#233 superseded, issue #235): <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s embedded script injects\n215\t    /// a title-band overlay after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/>\n216\t    /// for the folder path data. This method emits no anchor node, no <c>invisible</c> classDef, and\n217\t    /// no container <c>click</c> directive — only CHECK-node clicks, identical in shape to\n218\t    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>'s Mermaid source plus the click lines.\n219\t    /// </summary>\n220\t    public static string RenderInteractive(PlanDefinition plan)\n221\t    {\n222\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n223\t\n224\t        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n225\t        AppendLf(sb, \"flowchart TD\");\n226\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n227\t        AppendClassDefs(sb);\n228\t        AppendClickDirectives(plan, nodeIdBase, sb);\n229\t        return sb.ToString();\n230\t    }\n231\t\n232\t    /// <summary>\n233\t    /// The task-id → plan-relative folder path map <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> needs to inject\n234\t    /// the title-band click overlay (see class remarks, issue #235): a task container's click target\n235\t    /// is no longer a Mermaid-source mechanism, so this is how the same path data\n236\t    /// <see cref=\"AppendClickDirectives\"/> used to feed the removed anchor's <c>click href</c> now\n237\t    /// reaches the post-render JavaScript instead — as a small embedded JSON side-table keyed by the\n238\t    /// SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/> emits, so the\n239\t    /// overlay script can look a cluster's target up by its own DOM id. Plan-relative, forward-slash\n240\t    /// paths (not OS separators, not absolute) for the same byte-identical-across-OSes reason as\n241\t    /// <see cref=\"ToPlanRelative\"/>.\n242\t    /// </summary>\n243\t    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets(PlanDefinition plan)\n244\t    {\n245\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n246\t\n247\t        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n248\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n249\t\n250\t        var targets = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n251\t        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n252\t        {\n253\t            string containerId = $\"task_{nodeIdBase[task.Id]}\";\n254\t            targets[containerId] = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, task.Directory) + \"/\";\n255\t        }\n256\t\n257\t        return targets;\n258\t    }\n259\t\n260\t    /// <summary>\n261\t    /// The cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines (colors) for the LEAF check nodes — preflight check\n262\t    /// and guardrail check — which reference them inline via <c>:::preflight</c>/<c>:::guardrail</c>.\n263\t    /// The task-container and plan-level-container fills are applied per-container by a\n264\t    /// <c>style &lt;id&gt; …</c> statement instead (see <see cref=\"TaskStyle\"/> /\n265\t    /// <see cref=\"PlanLevelStyle\"/>), because a <c>class</c> assignment does not reach a subgraph\n266\t    /// that is an edge endpoint in the bundled Mermaid. Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n267\t    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n268\t    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n269\t    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n270\t    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n271\t    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n272\t    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n273\t    /// </summary>\n274\t    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7e0d4418-4132-42ae-ada4-ce0aaf87b22f","uuid":"c69a96a8-0752-4899-ab5c-a0f64b952a95","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:21:00.978Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Core\\Graph\\MermaidRenderer.cs","content":"    ///   <item>GitHub renders Mermaid in a sandboxed mode that disables clicks, so these would be\n    ///         inert in <c>diagram.md</c> — and the targets are <c>file://</c>-local anyway.</item>\n    ///   <item>They are deliberately NOT in <c>diagram.md</c> and NOT in the staleness hash\n    ///         (<see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>); the targets are derived deterministically from the\n    ///         same plan, as plan-relative forward-slash paths, so the output is byte-identical on\n    ///         every OS (no timestamp, no absolute path).</item>\n    /// </list>\n    /// A TASK CONTAINER's click target is NOT a Mermaid <c>click</c> directive at all (see class\n    /// remarks, \"A task container's click target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\" — issue\n    /// #232/#233 superseded, issue #235): <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s embedded script injects\n    /// a title-band overlay after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/>\n    /// for the folder path data. This method emits no anchor node, no <c>invisible</c> classDef, and\n    /// no container <c>click</c> directive — only CHECK-node clicks, identical in shape to\n    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>'s Mermaid source plus the click lines.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static string RenderInteractive(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n        AppendLf(sb, \"flowchart TD\");\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n        AppendClassDefs(sb);\n        AppendClickDirectives(plan, nodeIdBase, sb);\n        return sb.ToString();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The task-id → plan-relative folder path map <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> needs to inject\n    /// the title-band click overlay (see class remarks, issue #235): a task container's click target\n    /// is no longer a Mermaid-source mechanism, so this is how the same path data\n    /// <see cref=\"AppendClickDirectives\"/> used to feed the removed anchor's <c>click href</c> now\n    /// reaches the post-render JavaScript instead — as a small embedded JSON side-table keyed by the\n    /// SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/> emits, so the\n    /// overlay script can look a cluster's target up by its own DOM id. Plan-relative, forward-slash\n    /// paths (not OS separators, not absolute) for the same byte-identical-across-OSes reason as\n    /// <see cref=\"ToPlanRelative\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n\n        var targets = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            string containerId = $\"task_{nodeIdBase[task.Id]}\";\n            targets[containerId] = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, task.Directory) + \"/\";\n        }\n\n        return targets;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines (colors) for the LEAF check nodes — preflight check\n    /// and guardrail check — which reference them inline via <c>:::preflight</c>/<c>:::guardrail</c>.\n    /// The task-container and plan-level-container fills are applied per-container by a\n    /// <c>style &lt;id&gt; …</c> statement instead (see <see cref=\"TaskStyle\"/> /\n    /// <see cref=\"PlanLevelStyle\"/>), because a <c>class</c> assignment does not reach a subgraph\n    /// that is an edge endpoint in the bundled Mermaid. Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)","numLines":70,"startLine":205,"totalLines":648}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JqcgAeTJn1B2WBPokfm1NG","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n2\tusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\n3\tusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\n4\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n5\t\n6\tnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n7\t\n8\t/// <summary>\n9\t/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n10\t/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n11\t/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n12\t/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n13\t/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n14\t/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n15\t/// </summary>\n16\tpublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n17\t{\n18\t    [Fact]\n19\t    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n20\t    {\n21\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n22\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n23\t        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n24\t        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n25\t\n26\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n27\t            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n28\t            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n29\t\n30\t        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n31\t        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n32\t        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n33\t        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n34\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n35\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n36\t\n37\t        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n38\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n39\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n40\t        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n41\t        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n42\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n43\t\n44\t        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n45\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n46\t        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n47\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n48\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n50\t        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n51\t            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n52\t\n53\t        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n54\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    [Fact]\n58\t    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n59\t    {\n60\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n61\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n62\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n63\t\n64\t        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n65\t        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n66\t        var journal = new JournalDocument\n67\t        {\n68\t            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n69\t            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n70\t            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n71\t            {\n72\t                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n73\t            },\n74\t        };\n75\t\n76\t        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n77\t\n78\t        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n79\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n80\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n81\t    }\n82\t\n83\t    [Fact]\n84\t    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n85\t    {\n86\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n87\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n88\t        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n89\t\n90\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n91\t\n92\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n93\t        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n94\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n95\t\n96\t        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n97\t            inner.Events);\n98\t    }\n99\t\n100\t    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n101\t        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n102\t\n103\t    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n104\t    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n105\t    {\n106\t        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n107\t\n108\t        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n109\t        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n110\t        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n111\t    }\n112\t\n113\t    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n114\t    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n115\t    {\n116\t        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n117\t\n118\t        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n119\t\n120\t        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n121\t\n122\t        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n123\t\n124\t        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n125\t        {\n126\t            Id = id,\n127\t            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n128\t            Description = \"task \" + id,\n129\t            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n130\t            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n131\t        };\n132\t\n133\t        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n134\t        {\n135\t            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n136\t            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n137\t            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n138\t        }\n139\t\n140\t        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n141\t\n142\t        public void Dispose()\n143\t        {\n144\t            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n145\t        }\n146\t    }\n147\t}\n148\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7e0d4418-4132-42ae-ada4-ce0aaf87b22f","uuid":"64fb4afb-b5fb-4971-82e2-c13ce827d385","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:21:50.683Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n\n        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n\n        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n\n        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n\n        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n\n        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n        var journal = new JournalDocument\n        {\n            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n            {\n                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n            },\n        };\n\n        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n\n        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n\n        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n\n    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n        {\n            Id = id,\n            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n            Description = \"task \" + id,\n            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n        };\n\n        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n        {\n            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n        }\n\n        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":148,"startLine":1,"totalLines":148}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01K8XmSRjAubXwj1o59gxSJ6","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Core.Graph;\n2\t\n3\tnamespace Guardrails.Core.Tests;\n4\t\n5\t/// <summary>\n6\t/// Unit tests for <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> (issue #33): the self-contained local\n7\t/// <c>diagram.html</c> viewer. Pure string mapping — no disk. Pins the provenance line, the\n8\t/// verbatim-source embedding, the interaction prerequisites (loose security for clicks, pan/zoom,\n9\t/// fullscreen), determinism, and newline normalization.\n10\t/// </summary>\n11\tpublic sealed class HtmlDiagramRendererTests\n12\t{\n13\t    private const string Hash = \"abc123def456\";\n14\t    private const string Source = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_a[\\\"a\\\"]:::task\\n  classDef task fill:#cfe8ff;\";\n15\t\n16\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> NoTargets =\n17\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n18\t\n19\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> OneTarget =\n20\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_a\"] = \"tasks/01-a/\" };\n21\t\n22\t    [Fact]\n23\t    public void Render_FirstLine_IsProvenanceComment_WithSameHash()\n24\t    {\n25\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n26\t        string firstLine = html.Split('\\n')[0];\n27\t\n28\t        // Same provenance shape as diagram.md, and FIRST so the \\A-anchored reader (graph --check)\n29\t        // matches it in both files.\n30\t        Assert.Equal($\"<!-- guardrails:graph v1 source-sha256={Hash} -->\", firstLine);\n31\t    }\n32\t\n33\t    [Fact]\n34\t    public void Render_EmbedsSourceVerbatim_InRawTextScript()\n35\t    {\n36\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n37\t\n38\t        Assert.Contains(\"type=\\\"text/plain\\\"\", html);\n39\t        Assert.Contains(Source, html); // verbatim — not interpolated into a JS string\n40\t        Assert.Contains(\"<!doctype html>\", html);\n41\t    }\n42\t\n43\t    [Fact]\n44\t    public void Render_EnablesClicksAndNavigation()\n45\t    {\n46\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n47\t\n48\t        // Clicks (node -> source file) only fire when mermaid runs in 'loose' security.\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"securityLevel: 'loose'\", html);\n50\t        // Pan/zoom + fullscreen affordances.\n51\t        Assert.Contains(\"svg-pan-zoom\", html);\n52\t        Assert.Contains(\"requestFullscreen\", html);\n53\t    }\n54\t\n55\t    [Fact]\n56\t    public void Render_RaisesMermaidSizeCeilings_SoLargeDagsRender()\n57\t    {\n58\t        // Issue #108: a large plan's DAG source exceeds Mermaid's default 50 000-char maxTextSize\n59\t        // and/or 500-edge maxEdges ceiling, so mermaid.render throws and the page falls back to\n60\t        // \"could not render\". The fix lifts BOTH ceilings in mermaid.initialize — assert they are\n61\t        // present (a regression that drops either re-introduces the big-plan render failure).\n62\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n63\t\n64\t        Assert.Contains(\"maxTextSize: 5000000\", html);\n65\t        Assert.Contains(\"maxEdges: 100000\", html);\n66\t    }\n67\t\n68\t    [Fact]\n69\t    public void Render_IsDeterministic()\n70\t    {\n71\t        Assert.Equal(\n72\t            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget),\n73\t            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget));\n74\t    }\n75\t\n76\t    [Fact]\n77\t    public void Render_NormalizesCrlf_NoCarriageReturnsInOutput()\n78\t    {\n79\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\"flowchart TD\\r\\n  a-->b\\r\\n\", Hash, NoTargets);\n80\t        Assert.DoesNotContain('\\r', html);\n81\t    }\n82\t\n83\t    [Fact]\n84\t    public void Render_EmptyHash_Throws()\n85\t    {\n86\t        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, \"\", NoTargets));\n87\t    }\n88\t\n89\t    [Fact]\n90\t    public void Render_NullTaskFolderTargets_Throws()\n91\t    {\n92\t        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, null!));\n93\t    }\n94\t\n95\t    // === legend overlay (outside the Mermaid graph; see MermaidRenderer remarks) =======\n96\t\n97\t    [Fact]\n98\t    public void Render_IncludesALegendOverlayDiv_OutsideTheEmbeddedMermaidSource()\n99\t    {\n100\t        // A Mermaid-native legend was prototyped and rendered broken headless (dagre treats a\n101\t        // disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\"); the only working placement is an HTML\n102\t        // overlay div outside the embedded Mermaid <script> source, mirroring #bar/#hint.\n103\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n104\t\n105\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"legend\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n106\t    }\n107\t\n108\t    [Fact]\n109\t    public void Render_LegendOverlay_StatesBothAColorAndABeforeAfterTimingWord()\n110\t    {\n111\t        // A bare category name would not preserve the \"preflights run before, guardrails run\n112\t        // after\" semantic the removed nested boxes used to convey visually — the legend must spell\n113\t        // out both the colour mapping AND the timing/consequence in words.\n114\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n115\t\n116\t        Assert.Contains(\"Preflight\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n117\t        Assert.Contains(\"Guardrail\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n118\t        Assert.Contains(\"BEFORE\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n119\t        Assert.Contains(\"AFTER\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n120\t    }\n121\t\n122\t    [Fact]\n123\t    public void Render_LegendOverlay_IsNotInsideTheEmbeddedGraphSourceScript()\n124\t    {\n125\t        // The legend must live OUTSIDE the raw-text <script id=\"graph-source\"> element — it is\n126\t        // not part of the Mermaid source, so it can never affect anything that parses that source\n127\t        // (rendering) or hashes it (GraphSourceHash, via MermaidRenderer.SemanticContent).\n128\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n129\t\n130\t        int scriptStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"graph-source\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n131\t        int scriptEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", scriptStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n132\t        string scriptContent = html[scriptStart..scriptEnd];\n133\t\n134\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"legend\", scriptContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n135\t    }\n136\t\n137\t    // === task-container title-band overlay (issue #232/#233 superseded, issue #235) ====\n138\t    //\n139\t    // The Mermaid-source anchor-node mechanism (#211) proved useless in practice — a real\n140\t    // headless-Chrome measurement found the anchor covering only 0.44% of a content-dense\n141\t    // container's area, off-center, missed by every realistic click point. The fix instead\n142\t    // injects a post-render SVG overlay on the container's title/label band via JavaScript.\n143\t\n144\t    [Fact]\n145\t    public void Render_EmbedsTaskFolderTargets_AsJsonSideTable()\n146\t    {\n147\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n148\t\n149\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n150\t        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_a\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n151\t        Assert.Contains(\"tasks/01-a/\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n152\t    }\n153\t\n154\t    [Fact]\n155\t    public void Render_NoLongerEmitsAnchorNodeMechanism()\n156\t    {\n157\t        // The #211 anchor-node click mechanism (Mermaid-source invisible node + classDef) is\n158\t        // superseded entirely — HtmlDiagramRenderer must not reference it either.\n159\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n160\t\n161\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"classDef invisible\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n162\t    }\n163\t\n164\t    [Fact]\n165\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_AppendsToCluster_NotInsertsFirst()\n166\t    {\n167\t        // Load-bearing z-order fix: appendChild (not insertBefore as firstChild) — see class\n168\t        // remarks and HtmlDiagramRenderer's remarks for why insertBefore silently blocks clicks\n169\t        // (it lands the overlay BEHIND the cluster's own background rect).\n170\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n171\t\n172\t        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.appendChild(a)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n173\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"insertBefore(a, cluster.firstChild\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n174\t    }\n175\t\n176\t    [Fact]\n177\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_ComputesBandFromClusterAndLabelBBox()\n178\t    {\n179\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n180\t\n181\t        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n182\t        Assert.Contains(\"label.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n183\t        Assert.Contains(\".cluster-label\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n184\t    }\n185\t\n186\t    [Fact]\n187\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_UsesTransparentFill_NotNone()\n188\t    {\n189\t        // Same hit-testing hazard as the retired anchor node: fill:none is invisible to\n190\t        // pointer-events:visiblePainted hit-testing; the overlay rect must use a painted-but-\n191\t        // invisible transparent fill instead.\n192\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n193\t\n194\t        Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n195\t    }\n196\t\n197\t    [Fact]\n198\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_SetsFillViaInlineStyle_NotTheFillAttribute()\n199\t    {\n200\t        // Real-browser regression (found live, not guessed): Mermaid's own generated stylesheet\n201\t        // carries a rule shaped like `#dag .cluster rect{fill:<theme color>;...}`. Since the\n202\t        // overlay rect is nested inside the .cluster group, that selector matches it too — and a\n203\t        // CSS class/tag selector beats a plain HTML presentation attribute, so\n204\t        // `rect.setAttribute('fill', 'transparent')` was silently overridden, painting a solid\n205\t        // theme-colored bar over the container's title text (confirmed via getComputedStyle:\n206\t        // attribute said \"transparent\", computed fill was the theme's cluster-background color).\n207\t        // An inline style (`rect.style.fill = ...`) wins over any external/embedded stylesheet\n208\t        // rule short of `!important`, so it reliably stays invisible. This test would have caught\n209\t        // the regression: `Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\")` alone passes for EITHER form.\n210\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n211\t\n212\t        Assert.Contains(\"rect.style.fill = 'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n213\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"rect.setAttribute('fill'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n214\t    }\n215\t\n216\t    [Fact]\n217\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves()\n218\t    {\n219\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n220\t\n221\t        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n222\t        int overlayDefinition = html.IndexOf(\"function addTaskContainerOverlays\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n223\t        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && overlayDefinition >= 0, \"both the render call and overlay function must be present\");\n224\t\n225\t        // The overlay must be INVOKED after the render call (the definition itself may appear\n226\t        // earlier in the script — only invocation order matters for correctness).\n227\t        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n228\t        Assert.True(overlayInvocation > renderCall, \"the overlay must be applied to the SVG mermaid.render just produced\");\n229\t    }\n230\t\n231\t    [Fact]\n232\t    public void Render_EmptyTaskFolderTargets_StillRendersValidPage()\n233\t    {\n234\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n235\t\n236\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n237\t        Assert.Contains(\"{}\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n238\t    }\n239\t\n240\t    // === long task-name title wrap-overflow fix (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow) ====\n241\t    //\n242\t    // Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title <div> to a hardcoded 200px width (bundled\n243\t    // mermaid@11.4.1's plain flowchart cluster shape never overrides createText's width=200\n244\t    // default), and dagre's layout pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that\n245\t    // wrapped height is known — so a long kebab-case task name that wraps to 2+ lines prints past\n246\t    // the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box below it. No Mermaid\n247\t    // config knob avoids this (verified against the bundled 11.4.1 source). The fix re-wraps the\n248\t    // SAME text at up to the container's own (already wider) width post-render instead, verified\n249\t    // headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names, container widths ~230px-~1100px,\n250\t    // wraps of 2-3 lines): every case converged to one line with the same healthy gap a\n251\t    // never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label was left byte-for-byte\n252\t    // unchanged (including the whole golden hello-guardrails example).\n253\t\n254\t    [Fact]\n255\t    public void Render_DefinesFixWrappedClusterLabelsFunction()\n256\t    {\n257\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n258\t\n259\t        Assert.Contains(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels(svgEl)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n260\t    }\n261\t\n262\t    [Fact]\n263\t    public void Render_WrapFix_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves_AndBeforeTheOverlay()\n264\t    {\n265\t        // Ordering is load-bearing: addTaskContainerOverlays measures the label's CURRENT bbox to\n266\t        // size its click band, so a label the wrap fix already shrank back to one line must be\n267\t        // fixed FIRST, or the band would be sized for the original (possibly multi-line) wrap.\n268\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n269\t\n270\t        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n271\t        int wrapFixInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"fixWrappedClusterLabels(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n272\t        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n273\t\n274\t        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && wrapFixInvocation > renderCall && overlayInvocation > renderCall,\n275\t            \"both post-render fixes must be invoked after the render call\");\n276\t        Assert.True(wrapFixInvocation < overlayInvocation,\n277\t            \"the wrap fix must run BEFORE the title-band overlay so the band reflects the corrected label size\");\n278\t    }\n279\t\n280\t    [Fact]\n281\t    public void Render_WrapFix_MeasuresViaScrollWidth_NotGetBoundingClientRect()\n282\t    {\n283\t        // Regression guard for the exact measurement pitfall this fix's own investigation hit:\n284\t        // getBoundingClientRect() reports on-screen pixels affected by the page's pan-zoom\n285\t        // transform, which is misleading when compared against a foreignObject's local width/\n286\t        // height attributes. scrollWidth/scrollHeight are local layout-box measurements, in the\n287\t        // SAME coordinate system as those attributes, regardless of the current zoom level.\n288\t All five status values are exercised.\n360\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> SampleStatuses =\n361\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)\n362\t        {\n363\t            [\"plan_preflights\"] = \"passed\",       // Full Flight Checks bracket (top)\n364\t            [\"task_root\"] = \"running\",            // a task container, mid-run -> spinner\n365\t            [\"task_root_pf_0\"] = \"passed\",        // a preflight leaf check\n366\t            [\"task_root_gr_0\"] = \"failed\",        // a guardrail leaf check\n367\t            [\"task_next\"] = \"pending\",            // a not-yet-started task container\n368\t            [\"plan_guardrails\"] = \"needs-human\",  // Terminal Gate bracket (bottom)\n369\t        };\n370\t\n371\t    [Fact]\n372\t    public void Render_WithNullNodeStatuses_IsByteIdenticalToCurrentBehavior()\n373\t    {\n374\t        // The static `graph` command path (no live status) must be UNCHANGED by this feature: the\n375\t        // pre-existing three-argument overload and the new call passing nodeStatuses:null must\n376\t        // produce the exact same document, byte-for-byte — the golden fixtures\n377\t        // (examples/hello-guardrails, docs/plans/08-parallel-execution/diagram.html) are out of this\n378\t        // task's scope and must not need regenerating.\n379\t        string legacy = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n380\t        string newNull = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n381\t\n382\t        Assert.Equal(legacy, newNull);\n383\t\n384\t        // ...and the static path carries NONE of the live-overlay markers. Each of these is absent\n385\t        // from today's template, so their absence pins the null path clean — a leak of the feature\n386\t        // into the static path (which would silently change every checked-in diagram.html) fails here.\n387\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n388\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"@keyframes\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n389\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n390\t    }\n391\t\n392\t    [Fact]\n393\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAMetaRefreshTag()\n394\t    {\n395\t        // A non-null status map with the default includeRefresh:true is the DURING-RUN diagram — it\n396\t        // must carry <meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"> so a plain file:// view re-reads itself as the run\n397\t        // progresses (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run index). The static (null) path must not.\n398\t        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n399\t        Assert.Contains(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n400\t\n401\t        string stat = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n402\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", stat, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n403\t    }\n404\t\n405\t    [Fact]\n406\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatusesAndIncludeRefreshFalse_OmitsTheMetaRefreshTag()\n407\t    {\n408\t        // The FINAL settled render (wired at run-end by 06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand):\n409\t        // nodeStatuses is STILL non-null (every node shows its final settled status) but\n410\t        // includeRefresh:false, so the auto-reload tag is dropped — the page is done refreshing. The\n411\t        // status overlay itself must STILL be emitted (the refresh tag and the overlay are independent).\n412\t        string settled = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\n413\t            Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses, includeRefresh: false);\n414\t\n415\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n416\t        // still a live-status document — the overlay data is present regardless of includeRefresh.\n417\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n418\t        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_root\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n419\t    }\n420\t\n421\t    [Fact]\n422\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAnOverlayForEachStatusEntry()\n423\t    {\n424\t        // Every node id in the status map must be referenced by the overlay-rendering logic — the\n425\t        // map is embedded as a JSON side-table (mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table) keyed\n426\t        // by the SAME Mermaid node/container ids, so the post-render script can position a badge on\n427\t        // each matching SVG node. Assert the QUOTED (JSON-key) form: a bare-word check would false-\n428\t        // positive on ids like `plan_guardrails` that ALREADY appear in a code comment in today's\n429\t        // template — only the emitted status map produces the quoted form.\n430\t        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n431\t\n432\t        foreach (string nodeId in SampleStatuses.Keys)\n433\t        {\n434\t            Assert.Contains($\"\\\"{nodeId}\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n435\t        }\n436\t    }\n437\t\n438\t    [Fact]\n439\t    public void Render_WithRunningStatus_EmitsASpinnerClass_AndSettledStatusesEmitAGlyph()\n440\t    {\n441\t        // \"running\" must render an ANIMATED spinner (a CSS @keyframes rotation — no external\n442\t        // image/GIF dependency), visibly distinct from a settled status's STATIC glyph (check / X /\n443\t        // \"?\").
