Pure string mapping — no disk. Pins the provenance line, the\n/// verbatim-source embedding, the interaction prerequisites (loose security for clicks, pan/zoom,\n/// fullscreen), determinism, and newline normalization.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class HtmlDiagramRendererTests\n{\n    private const string Hash = \"abc123def456\";\n    private const string Source = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_a[\\\"a\\\"]:::task\\n  classDef task fill:#cfe8ff;\";\n\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> NoTargets =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> OneTarget =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_a\"] = \"tasks/01-a/\" };\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_FirstLine_IsProvenanceComment_WithSameHash()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n        string firstLine = html.Split('\\n')[0];\n\n        // Same provenance shape as diagram.md, and FIRST so the \\A-anchored reader (graph --check)\n        // matches it in both files.\n        Assert.Equal($\"<!-- guardrails:graph v1 source-sha256={Hash} -->\", firstLine);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmbedsSourceVerbatim_InRawTextScript()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"type=\\\"text/plain\\\"\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(Source, html); // verbatim — not interpolated into a JS string\n        Assert.Contains(\"<!doctype html>\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EnablesClicksAndNavigation()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        // Clicks (node -> source file) only fire when mermaid runs in 'loose' security.\n        Assert.Contains(\"securityLevel: 'loose'\", html);\n        // Pan/zoom + fullscreen affordances.\n        Assert.Contains(\"svg-pan-zoom\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(\"requestFullscreen\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_RaisesMermaidSizeCeilings_SoLargeDagsRender()\n    {\n        // Issue #108: a large plan's DAG source exceeds Mermaid's default 50 000-char maxTextSize\n        // and/or 500-edge maxEdges ceiling, so mermaid.render throws and the page falls back to\n        // \"could not render\". The fix lifts BOTH ceilings in mermaid.initialize — assert they are\n        // present (a regression that drops either re-introduces the big-plan render failure).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"maxTextSize: 5000000\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(\"maxEdges: 100000\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_IsDeterministic()\n    {\n        Assert.Equal(\n            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget),\n            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NormalizesCrlf_NoCarriageReturnsInOutput()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\"flowchart TD\\r\\n  a-->b\\r\\n\", Hash, NoTargets);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain('\\r', html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmptyHash_Throws()\n    {\n        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, \"\", NoTargets));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NullTaskFolderTargets_Throws()\n    {\n        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, null!));\n    }\n\n    // === legend overlay (outside the Mermaid graph; see MermaidRenderer remarks) =======\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_IncludesALegendOverlayDiv_OutsideTheEmbeddedMermaidSource()\n    {\n        // A Mermaid-native legend was prototyped and rendered broken headless (dagre treats a\n        // disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\"); the only working placement is an HTML\n        // overlay div outside the embedded Mermaid <script> source, mirroring #bar/#hint.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"legend\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_LegendOverlay_StatesBothAColorAndABeforeAfterTimingWord()\n    {\n        // A bare category name would not preserve the \"preflights run before, guardrails run\n        // after\" semantic the removed nested boxes used to convey visually — the legend must spell\n        // out both the colour mapping AND the timing/consequence in words.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"Preflight\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"Guardrail\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"BEFORE\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"AFTER\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_LegendOverlay_IsNotInsideTheEmbeddedGraphSourceScript()\n    {\n        // The legend must live OUTSIDE the raw-text <script id=\"graph-source\"> element — it is\n        // not part of the Mermaid source, so it can never affect anything that parses that source\n        // (rendering) or hashes it (GraphSourceHash, via MermaidRenderer.SemanticContent).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        int scriptStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"graph-source\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int scriptEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", scriptStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string scriptContent = html[scriptStart..scriptEnd];\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"legend\", scriptContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === task-container title-band overlay (issue #232/#233 superseded, issue #235) ====\n    //\n    // The Mermaid-source anchor-node mechanism (#211) proved useless in practice — a real\n    // headless-Chrome measurement found the anchor covering only 0.44% of a content-dense\n    // container's area, off-center, missed by every realistic click point. The fix instead\n    // injects a post-render SVG overlay on the container's title/label band via JavaScript.\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmbedsTaskFolderTargets_AsJsonSideTable()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_a\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"tasks/01-a/\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NoLongerEmitsAnchorNodeMechanism()\n    {\n        // The #211 anchor-node click mechanism (Mermaid-source invisible node + classDef) is\n        // superseded entirely — HtmlDiagramRenderer must not reference it either.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"classDef invisible\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_AppendsToCluster_NotInsertsFirst()\n    {\n        // Load-bearing z-order fix: appendChild (not insertBefore as firstChild) — see class\n        // remarks and HtmlDiagramRenderer's remarks for why insertBefore silently blocks clicks\n        // (it lands the overlay BEHIND the cluster's own background rect).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.appendChild(a)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"insertBefore(a, cluster.firstChild\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_ComputesBandFromClusterAndLabelBBox()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"label.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\".cluster-label\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_UsesTransparentFill_NotNone()\n    {\n        // Same hit-testing hazard as the retired anchor node: fill:none is invisible to\n        // pointer-events:visiblePainted hit-testing; the overlay rect must use a painted-but-\n        // invisible transparent fill instead.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_SetsFillViaInlineStyle_NotTheFillAttribute()\n    {\n        // Real-browser regression (found live, not guessed): Mermaid's own generated stylesheet\n        // carries a rule shaped like `#dag .cluster rect{fill:<theme color>;...}`. Since the\n        // overlay rect is nested inside the .cluster group, that selector matches it too — and a\n        // CSS class/tag selector beats a plain HTML presentation attribute, so\n        // `rect.setAttribute('fill', 'transparent')` was silently overridden, painting a solid\n        // theme-colored bar over the container's title text (confirmed via getComputedStyle:\n        // attribute said \"transparent\", computed fill was the theme's cluster-background color).\n        // An inline style (`rect.style.fill = ...`) wins over any external/embedded stylesheet\n        // rule short of `!important`, so it reliably stays invisible. This test would have caught\n        // the regression: `Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\")` alone passes for EITHER form.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"rect.style.fill = 'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"rect.setAttribute('fill'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int overlayDefinition = html.IndexOf(\"function addTaskContainerOverlays\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && overlayDefinition >= 0, \"both the render call and overlay function must be present\");\n\n        // The overlay must be INVOKED after the render call (the definition itself may appear\n        // earlier in the script — only invocation order matters for correctness).\n        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(overlayInvocation > renderCall, \"the overlay must be applied to the SVG mermaid.render just produced\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmptyTaskFolderTargets_StillRendersValidPage()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"{}\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === long task-name title wrap-overflow fix (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow) ====\n    //\n    // Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title <div> to a hardcoded 200px width (bundled\n    // mermaid@11.4.1's plain flowchart cluster shape never overrides createText's width=200\n    // default), and dagre's layout pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that\n    // wrapped height is known — so a long kebab-case task name that wraps to 2+ lines prints past\n    // the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box below it. No Mermaid\n    // config knob avoids this (verified against the bundled 11.4.1 source). The fix re-wraps the\n    // SAME text at up to the container's own (already wider) width post-render instead, verified\n    // headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names, container widths ~230px-~1100px,\n    // wraps of 2-3 lines): every case converged to one line with the same healthy gap a\n    // never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label was left byte-for-byte\n    // unchanged (including the whole golden hello-guardrails example).\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_DefinesFixWrappedClusterLabelsFunction()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels(svgEl)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves_AndBeforeTheOverlay()\n    {\n        // Ordering is load-bearing: addTaskContainerOverlays measures the label's CURRENT bbox to\n        // size its click band, so a label the wrap fix already shrank back to one line must be\n        // fixed FIRST, or the band would be sized for the original (possibly multi-line) wrap.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int wrapFixInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"fixWrappedClusterLabels(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && wrapFixInvocation > renderCall && overlayInvocation > renderCall,\n            \"both post-render fixes must be invoked after the render call\");\n        Assert.True(wrapFixInvocation < overlayInvocation,\n            \"the wrap fix must run BEFORE the title-band overlay so the band reflects the corrected label size\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_MeasuresViaScrollWidth_NotGetBoundingClientRect()\n    {\n        // Regression guard for the exact measurement pitfall this fix's own investigation hit:\n        // getBoundingClientRect() reports on-screen pixels affected by the page's pan-zoom\n        // transform, which is misleading when compared against a foreignObject's local width/\n        // height attributes. scrollWidth/scrollHeight are local layout-box measurements, in the\n        // SAME coordinate system as those attributes, regardless of the current zoom level.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int fnStart = html.IndexOf(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int fnEnd = html.IndexOf(\"\\n}\\n\", fnStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string fnBody = html[fnStart..fnEnd];\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollWidth\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollHeight\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"getBoundingClientRect\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_NeverNarrowsBelowMermaidsOriginalWidth()\n    {\n        // The fix only ever WIDENS a label (fewer lines needs less height, never more) — it must\n        // never choose a width narrower than what Mermaid already assigned, which would be a\n        // regression risking MORE wrapping, not less.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"Math.max(currentWidth, clusterBox.width - 16)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_SkipsLabelsThatAlreadyFitOnOneLine()\n    {\n        // Short names (e.g. every task in the golden hello-guardrails example) must be left\n        // completely untouched — this is the guard that makes that a no-op.\n        string html = =====================================\n    //\n    // While a `guardrails run` is in progress, diagram.html gains a small corner-anchored status\n    // badge on each task container, preflight/guardrail leaf, and the plan-level Full Flight Checks\n    // / Terminal Gate brackets: an animated spinner while running, a settled check/X/\"?\" glyph once\n    // finished — driven by an The\n    // four non-null-status tests are the intended TDD RED against the throwing stub — the\n    // 02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer task turns them green.\n    //\n    // Status-map ids use the SAME vocabulary MermaidRenderer emits (task containers `task_<base>`,\n    // preflight/guardrail leaves `task_<base>_pf_<n>`/`task_<base>_gr_<n>`, and the two plan-level\n    // brackets `plan_preflights`/`plan_guardrails`) so the post-render overlay script can position a\n    // badge on the matching SVG node. All five status values are exercised.\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> SampleStatuses =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)\n        {\n            [\"plan_preflights\"] = \"passed\",       // Full Flight Checks bracket (top)\n            [\"task_root\"] = \"running\",            // a task container, mid-run -> spinner\n            [\"task_root_pf_0\"] = \"passed\",        // a preflight leaf check\n            [\"task_root_gr_0\"] = \"failed\",        // a guardrail leaf check\n            [\"task_next\"] = \"pending\",            // a not-yet-started task container\n            [\"plan_guardrails\"] = \"needs-human\",  // Terminal Gate bracket (bottom)\n        };\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNullNodeStatuses_IsByteIdenticalToCurrentBehavior()\n    {\n        // The static `graph` command path (no live status) must be UNCHANGED by this feature: the\n        // pre-existing three-argument overload and the new call passing nodeStatuses:null must\n        // produce the exact same document, byte-for-byte — the golden fixtures\n        // (examples/hello-guardrails, docs/plans/08-parallel-execution/diagram.html) are out of this\n        // task's scope and must not need regenerating.\n        string legacy = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n        string newNull = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n\n        Assert.Equal(legacy, newNull);\n\n        // ...and the static path carries NONE of the live-overlay markers. Each of these is absent\n        // from today's template, so their absence pins the null path clean — a leak of the feature\n        // into the static path (which would silently change every checked-in diagram.html) fails here.\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"@keyframes\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAMetaRefreshTag()\n    {\n        // A non-null status map with the default includeRefresh:true is the DURING-RUN diagram — it\n        // must carry <meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"> so a plain file:// view re-reads itself as the run\n        // progresses (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run index). The static (null) path must not.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n        Assert.Contains(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        string stat = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", stat, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatusesAndIncludeRefreshFalse_OmitsTheMetaRefreshTag()\n    {\n        // The FINAL settled render (wired at run-end by 06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand):\n        // nodeStatuses is STILL non-null (every node shows its final settled status) but\n        // includeRefresh:false, so the auto-reload tag is dropped — the page is done refreshing. The\n        // status overlay itself must STILL be emitted (the refresh tag and the overlay are independent).\n        string settled = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\n            Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses, includeRefresh: false);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        // still a live-status document — the overlay data is present regardless of includeRefresh.\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_root\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAnOverlayForEachStatusEntry()\n    {\n        // Every node id in the status map must be referenced by the overlay-rendering logic — the\n        // map is embedded as a JSON side-table (mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table) keyed\n        // by the SAME Mermaid node/container ids, so the post-render script can position a badge on\n        // each matching SVG node. Assert the QUOTED (JSON-key) form: a bare-word check would false-\n        // positive on ids like `plan_guardrails` that ALREADY appear in a code comment in today's\n        // template — only the emitted status map produces the quoted form.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n\n        foreach (string nodeId in SampleStatuses.Keys)\n        {\n            Assert.Contains($\"\\\"{nodeId}\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        }\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithRunningStatus_EmitsASpinnerClass_AndSettledStatusesEmitAGlyph()\n    {\n        // \"running\" must render an ANIMATED spinner (a CSS @keyframes rotation — no external\n        // image/GIF dependency), visibly distinct from a settled status's STATIC glyph (check / X /\n        // \"?\"). Assert both the spinner animation + its dedicated class AND at least one settled\n        // glyph are present; the spinner marker (a CSS class) is inherently distinct from the glyph\n        // characters, so a spinner can never be mistaken for a settled state.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n\n        // spinner: a CSS keyframes rotation + a dedicated class (neither exists in the static template).\n        Assert.Contains(\"@keyframes\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"status-spinner\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        // settled glyphs: `passed` -> U+2713 CHECK MARK, `failed` -> U+2717 BALLOT X (both present in\n        // SampleStatuses). Written as literal UTF-8 glyphs; this file is valid UTF-8, which Roslyn's\n        // BOM-less source detection decodes as UTF-8, so the literals compile to exactly these chars.\n        Assert.Contains(\"✓\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"✗\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":459,"startLine":1,"totalLines":459}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GVDysnMBsVMpgwUoGk7DRj","type":"tool_result","content":"370\t    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n371\t    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n372\t    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n373\t    /// </summary>\n374\t    /// <remarks>\n375\t    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n376\t    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n377\t    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n378\t    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n379\t    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n380\t    /// </remarks>\n381\t    /// <remarks>\n382\t    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n383\t    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n384\t    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n385\t    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n386\t    /// </remarks>\n387\t    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n388\t    {\n389\t        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n390\t\n391\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n392\t\n393\t        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n394\t        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n395\t        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n396\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n397\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n398\t\n399\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n400\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n401\t    }\n402\t\n403\t    /// <summary>\n404\t    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n405\t    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n406\t    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n407\t    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n408\t    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n409\t    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n410\t    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n411\t    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n412\t    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n413\t    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n414\t    /// needed anywhere now.\n415\t    /// </summary>\n416\t    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n417\t        StringBuilder sb,\n418\t        string indent,\n419\t        string nodeIdPrefix,\n420\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n421\t        string checkClass)\n422\t    {\n423\t        int ordinal = 0;\n424\t        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n425\t        {\n426\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n427\t            ordinal++;\n428\t        }\n429\t    }\n430\t\n431\t    /// <summary>\n432\t    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n433\t    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n434\t    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n435\t    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n436\t    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n437\t    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n438\t    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n439\t    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n440\t    /// </summary>\n441\t    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n442\t        DependencyGraph graph,\n443\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n444\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n445\t        StringBuilder sb)\n446\t    {\n447\t        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n448\t        {\n449\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n450\t        }\n451\t\n452\t        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n453\t        {\n454\t            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n455\t                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n456\t            {\n457\t                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n458\t            }\n459\t        }\n460\t\n461\t        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n462\t        {\n463\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n464\t        }\n465\t    }\n466\t\n467\t    /// <summary>\n468\t    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n469\t    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n470\t    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n471\t    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n472\t    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n473\t    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n474\t    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n475\t    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n476\t    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n477\t    /// </summary>\n478\t    /// <remarks>\n479\t    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click\n480\t    /// target is no longer a Mermaid mechanism at all — see class remarks, \"A task container's click\n481\t    /// target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\". <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects it via\n482\t    /// JavaScript after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/> for the\n483\t    /// folder path data. Leaf check-node clicks are unaffected here: they still target the leaf node\n484\t    /// itself, which Mermaid DOES wrap in a real clickable <c>&lt;a href&gt;</c>.\n485\t    /// </remarks>\n486\t    private static void AppendClickDirectives(\n487\t        PlanDefinition plan, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase, StringBuilder sb)\n488\t    {\n489\t        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanPreflights, PlanPreflightsId, sb);\n490\t\n491\t        foreach (TaskNode task in plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n492\t        {\n493\t            string @base = nodeIdBase[task.Id];\n494\t            string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n495\t\n496\t            if (task.Preflights.Count > 0)\n497\t            {\n498\t                AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Preflights, $\"{containerId}_pf\", sb);\n499\t            }\n500\t\n501\t            AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Guardrails, $\"{containerId}_gr\", sb);\n502\t        }\n503\t\n504\t        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanGuardrails, PlanGuardrailsId, sb);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    /// <summary>\n508\t    /// Append one <c>click</c> directive per check in <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by\n509\t    /// name, mirroring <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> exactly so the ordinal-suffixed node id each"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da2f6e1b-c0c0-42fe-a3cc-1b97143051eb","uuid":"74c47d18-b657-45b2-9dc5-cb00c4c78856","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:33:10.106Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"src\\Guardrails.Core\\Graph\\MermaidRenderer.cs","content":"    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n    /// </remarks>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n    {\n        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n\n        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n    /// needed anywhere now.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n        StringBuilder sb,\n        string indent,\n        string nodeIdPrefix,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string checkClass)\n    {\n        int ordinal = 0;\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n            ordinal++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n        DependencyGraph graph,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n        StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n        {\n            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n            {\n                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click\n    /// target is no longer a Mermaid mechanism at all — see class remarks, \"A task container's click\n    /// target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\". <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects it via\n    /// JavaScript after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/> for the\n    /// folder path data. Leaf check-node clicks are unaffected here: they still target the leaf node\n    /// itself, which Mermaid DOES wrap in a real clickable <c>&lt;a href&gt;</c>.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static void AppendClickDirectives(\n        PlanDefinition plan, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase, StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanPreflights, PlanPreflightsId, sb);\n\n        foreach (TaskNode task in plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            string @base = nodeIdBase[task.Id];\n            string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n\n            if (task.Preflights.Count > 0)\n            {\n                AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Preflights, $\"{containerId}_pf\", sb);\n            }\n\n            AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Guardrails, $\"{containerId}_gr\", sb);\n        }\n\n        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanGuardrails, PlanGuardrailsId, sb);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append one <c>click</c> directive per check in <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by\n    /// name, mirroring <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> exactly so the ordinal-suffixed node id each","numLines":140,"startLine":370,"totalLines":648}}}

 /// </summary>\n    public ScriptPlanBuilder AddTask(\n        string id,\n        bool actionSucceeds = true,\n        bool guardrailPasses = true,\n        params string[] dependsOn)\n    {\n        string taskDir = Path.Combine(_root, \"tasks\", id);\n        Directory.CreateDirectory(taskDir);\n        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(taskDir, \"guardrails\"));\n        _taskFolders.Add(taskDir);\n\n        string dependsJson = dependsOn.Length == 0\n            ? \"[]\"\n            : \"[\" + string.Join(\", \", dependsOn.Select(d => $\"\\\"{d}\\\"\")) + \"]\";\n\n        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(taskDir, \"task.json\"),\n            $$\"\"\"\n            {\n              \"description\": \"Integration task {{id}}\",\n              \"dependsOn\": {{dependsJson}}\n            }\n            \"\"\");\n\n        WriteScript(Path.Combine(taskDir, ActionFileName), Body(actionSucceeds, \"action\"));\n        WriteScript(Path.Combine(taskDir, \"guardrails\", GuardrailFileName), Body(guardrailPasses, \"guardrail\"));\n\n        return this;\n    }\n\n    private static string ActionFileName => UsePowerShell ? \"action.ps1\" : \"action.sh\";\n    private static string GuardrailFileName => UsePowerShell ? \"01-check.ps1\" : \"01-check.sh\";\n\n    private static string Body(bool succeeds, string label)\n    {\n        if (UsePowerShell)\n        {\n            var sb = new StringBuilder();\n            if (!succeeds)\n            {\n                sb.AppendLine($\"Write-Output \\\"{label} failed deliberately\\\"\");\n                sb.AppendLine(\"exit 1\");\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                sb.AppendLine($\"Write-Output \\\"{label} ok\\\"\");\n                sb.AppendLine(\"exit 0\");\n            }\n            return sb.ToString();\n        }\n\n        var bash = new StringBuilder();\n        bash.AppendLine(\"#!/usr/bin/env bash\");\n        if (!succeeds)\n        {\n            bash.AppendLine($\"echo \\\"{label} failed deliberately\\\"\");\n            bash.AppendLine(\"exit 1\");\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            bash.AppendLine($\"echo \\\"{label} ok\\\"\");\n            bash.AppendLine(\"exit 0\");\n        }\n        return bash.ToString();\n    }\n\n    private static void WriteScript(string path, string content)\n    {\n        File.WriteAllText(path, content);\n        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())\n        {\n            // Make the .sh executable bit irrelevant (we spawn via bash), but harmless to set.\n            File.SetUnixFileMode(path,\n                UnixFileMode.UserRead | UnixFileMode.UserWrite | UnixFileMode.UserExecute |\n                UnixFileMode.GroupRead | UnixFileMode.OtherRead);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void Dispose()\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            if (Directory.Exists(_root))\n            {\n                Directory.Delete(_root, recursive: true);\n            }\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // Best-effort cleanup; a locked file should not fail the test.\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":136,"startLine":1,"totalLines":136}}}

Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n14\t/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n15\t/// </summary>\n16\tpublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n17\t{\n18\t    [Fact]\n19\t    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n20\t    {\n21\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n22\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n23\t        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n24\t        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n25\t\n26\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n27\t            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n28\t            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n29\t\n30\t        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n31\t        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n32\t        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n33\t        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n34\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n35\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n36\t\n37\t        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n38\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n39\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n40\t        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n41\t        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n42\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n43\t\n44\t        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n45\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n46\t        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n47\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n48\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n50\t        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n51\t            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n52\t\n53\t        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n54\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    [Fact]\n58\t    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n59\t    {\n60\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n61\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n62\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n63\t\n64\t        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n65\t        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n66\t        var journal = new JournalDocument\n67\t        {\n68\t            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n69\t            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n70\t            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n71\t            {\n72\t                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n73\t            },\n74\t        };\n75\t\n76\t        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n77\t\n78\t        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n79\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n145\t        }\n146\t    }\n147\t}\n148\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da2f6e1b-c0c0-42fe-a3cc-1b97143051eb","uuid":"715e5913-8ae7-492c-9244-bff6ee9420eb","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:34:41.588Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n\n        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n\n        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n\n        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n\n        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n\n        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n        var journal = new JournalDocument\n        {\n            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n            {\n                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n            },\n        };\n\n        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n\n        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n\n        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n\n    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n        {\n            Id = id,\n            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n            Description = \"task \" + id,\n            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n        };\n\n        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n        {\n            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n        }\n\n        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":148,"startLine":1,"totalLines":148}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cco2Ct48MC6pXTAVcNJYN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01W2B8fbNs4rJrKKdSphhdN9","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Cli\\Ui\\OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// A decorator <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> that keeps the DURING-RUN live diagram\n/// (<c>diagram.html</c>, issue #219) up to date as the run proceeds, mirroring\n/// <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s exact shape for the analogous log site. Wraps the real\n/// observer (<c>_inner</c>), forwards every event verbatim, and — after <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/>,\n/// <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/>, and <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> — re-renders <c>diagram.html</c>\n/// from an in-memory per-node status map (task containers and their guardrail leaves) via\n/// <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>.\n/// </summary>\n/// <remarks>\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Constructor choice:</b> the Mermaid source, its <c>source-sha256</c>, and the\n/// task-folder-targets map are threaded through the CONSTRUCTOR rather than read back out of the\n/// already-written <c>diagram.html</c>. The composition root that will construct this observer\n/// (a later task, wiring it into <c>RunCommand</c>) computes these the same way <c>guardrails\n/// graph</c> does, so handing them straight in is simpler than re-parsing the HTML this observer\n/// itself just wrote.\n/// </para>\n/// <para>\n/// Like <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, this decorator's own status map is the only shared\n/// mutable state, and M4 worker threads call in concurrently, so all access to it — and the render\n/// that projects from it — is serialised under one <see cref=\"_gate\"/> lock. Renders are\n/// best-effort: a render failure (e.g. a transient file lock) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n/// </para>\n/// <para>\n/// STUB (03-author-tests-diagram-observer): the actual render/write step\n/// (<see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/>) is not implemented yet — it throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/>.\n/// That is the intended TDD RED this task establishes; 04-implement-diagram-observer turns it green.\n/// </para>\n/// </remarks>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> _tasks;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly string _diagramHtmlPath;\n    private readonly string _mermaidSource;\n    private readonly string _sourceHash;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _taskFolderTargets;\n\n    // Per-node status word (task containers + their guardrail leaves), seeded \"pending\". Mutated\n    // and projected under one lock — events arrive from concurrent M4 workers, and the render reads\n    // the whole map, so the two must not race.\n    private readonly object _gate = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByNode;\n\n    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — seeds the initial \"pending\" status map.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"diagramHtmlPath\">Absolute path to the plan's <c>diagram.html</c> to (re)write.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"mermaidSource\">\n    /// The exact Mermaid source rendered into <c>diagram.md</c>/<c>diagram.html</c> (same text\n    /// <c>guardrails graph</c> computed), passed through verbatim to each re-render.\n    /// </param>\n    /// <param name=\"sourceHash\">The <c>source-sha256</c> provenance stamp for <paramref name=\"mermaidSource\"/>.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"taskFolderTargets\">The task-container-id → plan-relative-folder-path map (see\n    /// <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>).</param>\n    public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n        IRunObserver inner,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        string diagramHtmlPath,\n        string mermaidSource,\n        string sourceHash,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> taskFolderTargets)\n    {\n        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n        _tasks = tasks ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tasks));\n        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        _diagramHtmlPath = diagramHtmlPath ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(diagramHtmlPath));\n        _mermaidSource = mermaidSource ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mermaidSource));\n        _sourceHash = sourceHash ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceHash));\n        _taskFolderTargets = taskFolderTargets ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(taskFolderTargets));\n\n        _statusByNode = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            _statusByNode[TaskNodeId(task)] = \"pending\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(TaskNodeId(task), \"running\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n        SetStatus(GuardrailNodeId(task, result.Name), result.Passed ? \"passed\" : \"failed\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n        {\n            SetStatus(TaskNodeId(task), StatusWord(result.Outcome));\n        }\n\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n\n    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n\n    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n\n    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n\n    // --- diagram projection -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void SetStatus(string nodeId, string status)\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            _statusByNode[nodeId] = status;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Rewrite <c>diagram.html</c> from the current status map. Holds the lock for the whole render\n    /// so the status snapshot passed to <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> is consistent. Best-effort — a\n    /// render failure never flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void Render()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            var statuses = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByNode, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => WriteDiagram(statuses));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Render <paramref name=\"statuses\"/> via <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>\n    /// and write it to <see cref=\"_diagramHtmlPath\"/>. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (03-author-tests-diagram-observer\n    /// is tests + stub only) — 04-implement-diagram-observer fills this in.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void WriteDiagram(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses)\n    {\n        _ = _mermaidSource;\n        _ = _sourceHash;\n        _ = _taskFolderTargets;\n        _ = statuses;\n        throw new NotImplementedException();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Run a render action, swallowing IO failures: the on-the-fly diagram is a UX nicety and must\n    /// never flip a task's outcome or abort the run. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the\n    /// next event. Mirrors <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s identical helper.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a diagram-file permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Mermaid container id for a task (mirrors <c>MermaidRenderer</c>'s <c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c> scheme).</summary>\n    private static string TaskNodeId(TaskNode task) => $\"task_{SanitizeId(task.Id)}\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Mermaid leaf-node id for a named guardrail on <paramref name=\"task\"/> (mirrors\n    /// <c>MermaidRenderer</c>'s <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;ordinal&gt;</c> scheme — ordinal by\n    /// name, ordinally sorted, 0-based).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static string GuardrailNodeId(TaskNode task, string guardrailName)\n    {\n        List<GuardrailDefinition> sorted = task.Guardrails\n            .OrderBy(g => g.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n            .ToList();\n        int ordinal = Math.Max(0, sorted.FindIndex(g => g.Name == guardrailName));\n        return $\"{TaskNodeId(task)}_gr_{ordinal}\";\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Every character that is not an ASCII letter/digit becomes <c>_</c> (kebab <c>-</c> → <c>_</c>).</summary>\n    private static string SanitizeId(string id)\n    {\n        var chars = new char[id.Length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < id.Length; i++)\n        {\n            char c = id[i];\n            chars[i] = c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or (>= '0' and <= '9') ? Wraps the real\n/// observer (<c>_inner</c>), forwards every event verbatim, and — after <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/>,\n/// <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/>, and <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> — re-renders <c>diagram.html</c>\n/// from an in-memory per-node status map (task containers and their guardrail leaves) via\n/// <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>.\n/// </summary>\n/// <remarks>\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Constructor choice:</b> the Mermaid source, its <c>source-sha256</c>, and the\n/// task-folder-targets map are threaded through the CONSTRUCTOR rather than read back out of the\n/// already-written <c>diagram.html</c>. The composition root that will construct this observer\n/// (a later task, wiring it into <c>RunCommand</c>) computes these the same way <c>guardrails\n/// graph</c> does, so handing them straight in is simpler than re-parsing the HTML this observer\n/// itself just wrote.\n/// </para>\n/// <para>\n/// Like <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, this decorator's own status map is the only shared\n/// mutable state, and M4 worker threads call in concurrently, so all access to it — and the render\n/// that projects from it — is serialised under one <see cref=\"_gate\"/> lock. Renders are\n/// best-effort: a render failure (e.g. a transient file lock) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n/// </para>\n/// <para>\n/// STUB (03-author-tests-diagram-observer): the actual render/write step\n/// (<see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/>) is not implemented yet — it throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/>.\n/// That is the intended TDD RED this task establishes; 04-implement-diagram-observer turns it green.\n/// </para>\n/// </remarks>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> _tasks;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly string _diagramHtmlPath;\n    private readonly string _mermaidSource;\n    private readonly string _sourceHash;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _taskFolderTargets;\n\n    // Per-node status word (task containers + their guardrail leaves), seeded \"pending\". Mutated\n    // and projected under one lock — events arrive from concurrent M4 workers, and the render reads\n    // the whole map, so the two must not race.\n    private readonly object _gate = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByNode;\n\n    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — seeds the initial \"pending\" status map.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"diagramHtmlPath\">Absolute path to the plan's <c>diagram.html</c> to (re)write.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"mermaidSource\">\n    /// The exact Mermaid source rendered into <c>diagram.md</c>/<c>diagram.html</c> (same text\n    /// <c>guardrails graph</c> computed), passed through verbatim to each re-render.\n    /// </param>\n    /// <param name=\"sourceHash\">The <c>source-sha256</c> provenance stamp for <paramref name=\"mermaidSource\"/>.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"taskFolderTargets\">The task-container-id → plan-relative-folder-path map (see\n    /// <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>).</param>\n    public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n        IRunObserver inner,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        string diagramHtmlPath,\n        string mermaidSource,\n        string sourceHash,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> taskFolderTargets)\n    {\n        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n        _tasks = tasks ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tasks));\n        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        _diagramHtmlPath = diagramHtmlPath ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(diagramHtmlPath));\n        _mermaidSource = mermaidSource ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mermaidSource));\n        _sourceHash = sourceHash ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceHash));\n        _taskFolderTargets = taskFolderTargets ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(taskFolderTargets));\n\n        _statusByNode = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            _statusByNode[TaskNodeId(task)] = \"pending\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(TaskNodeId(task), \"running\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n        SetStatus(GuardrailNodeId(task, result.Name), result.Passed ? \"passed\" : \"failed\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n        {\n            SetStatus(TaskNodeId(task), StatusWord(result.Outcome));\n        }\n\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n\n    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n\n    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n\n    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n\n    // --- diagram projection -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void SetStatus(string nodeId, string status)\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            _statusByNode[nodeId] = status;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Rewrite <c>diagram.html</c> from the current status map. Holds the lock for the whole render\n    /// so the status snapshot passed to <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> is consistent. Best-effort — a\n    /// render failure never flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void Render()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            var statuses = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByNode, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => WriteDiagram(statuses));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Render <paramref name=\"statuses\"/> via <see cref=\"Guardrails.Core.Graph.HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>\n    /// and write it to <see cref=\"_diagramHtmlPath\"/>. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (03-author-tests-diagram-observer\n    /// is tests + stub only) — 04-implement-diagram-observer fills this in.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void WriteDiagram(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses)\n    {\n        _ = _mermaidSource;\n        _ = _sourceHash;\n        _ = _taskFolderTargets;\n        _ = statuses;\n        throw new NotImplementedException();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Run a render action, swallowing IO failures: the on-the-fly diagram is a UX nicety and must\n    /// never flip a task's outcome or abort the run. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the\n    /// next event. Mirrors <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s identical helper.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a diagram-file permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Mermaid container id for a task (mirrors <c>MermaidRenderer</c>'s <c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c> scheme).</summary>\n    private static string TaskNodeId(TaskNode task) => $\"task_{SanitizeId(task.Id)}\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Mermaid leaf-node id for a named guardrail on <paramref name=\"task\"/> (mirrors\n    /// <c>MermaidRenderer</c>'s <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;ordinal&gt;</c> scheme — ordinal by\n    /// name, ordinally sorted, 0-based).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static string GuardrailNodeId(TaskNode task, string guardrailName)\n    {\n        List<GuardrailDefinition> sorted = task.Guardrails\n            .OrderBy(g => g.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n            .ToList();\n        int ordinal = Math.Max(0, sorted.FindIndex(g => g.Name == guardrailName));\n        return $\"{TaskNodeId(task)}_gr_{ordinal}\";\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Every character that is not an ASCII letter/digit becomes <c>_</c> (kebab <c>-</c> → <c>_</c>).</summary>\n    private static string SanitizeId(string id)\n    {\n        var chars = new char[id.Length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < id.Length; i++)\n        {\n            char c = id[i];\n            chars[i] = c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or (>= '0' and <= '9') ? c : '_';\n        }\n\n        return new string(chars);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Map a finished task's outcome to the diagram status word.</summary>\n    private static string StatusWord(TaskOutcome outcome) => outcome switch\n    {\n        TaskOutcome.Succeeded or TaskOutcome.Skipped => \"passed\",\n        TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman or TaskOutcome.RateLimited => \"needs-human\",\n        _ => \"failed\",\n    };\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
