{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cco2FRqd7qsbddyeXbvQx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Xs9u8fc5MVP7avZbxfjMHW","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests.cs","content":"using System.Text.Json;\nusing Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Exercises the on-the-fly diagram decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyDiagramObserver\"/>, issue #219):\n/// as tasks and guardrails settle it rewrites <c>diagram.html</c>'s embedded <c>#node-statuses</c>\n/// side-table so a live view of the run's progress is browsable. Driven directly against the\n/// decorator (no real Scheduler) — a focused unit test of the projection logic and of the\n/// pass-through of every other <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> event.\n/// </summary>\n/// <remarks>\n/// The decorator is currently a STUB (03-author-tests-diagram-observer): its render/write step\n/// throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> unconditionally. Every test below that triggers a\n/// render is expected to FAIL against that stub — this is the intended TDD RED that\n/// 04-implement-diagram-observer turns green. <see cref=\"EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged\"/>\n/// touches no rendering path, so it is expected to pass even against the stub.\n/// </remarks>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests\n{\n    private const string MermaidSource = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_01_alpha[\\\"01-alpha\\\"]:::task\\n\";\n    private const string SourceHash = \"abc123\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void TaskStarting_RerendersDiagramWithTheTaskMarkedRunning()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(task);\n\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"running\", statuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void GuardrailFinished_RerendersDiagramWithThatChecksSettledStatus()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\", \"01-x\", \"02-y\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> afterPass = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", afterPass.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_0\"));\n        // Only that specific check's node flips — not the whole task container.\n        Assert.Equal(\"pending\", afterPass.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"02-y\", Passed = false });\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> afterFail = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"failed\", afterFail.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_1\"));\n        // The first check's settled status is untouched by the second check finishing.\n        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", afterFail.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_0\"));\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.Succeeded, \"passed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.GuardrailFailed, \"failed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman, \"needs-human\")]\n    public void TaskFinished_RerendersDiagramWithTheTasksSettledStatus(TaskOutcome outcome, string expectedStatus)\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskFinished(new TaskResult { TaskId = \"01-alpha\", Outcome = outcome, Summary = \"done\" });\n\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, statuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(inner, [task]);\n\n        observer.AttemptStarting(task, 2, 3);\n        observer.PlanHashMismatch(\"sha256:deadbeef\");\n        observer.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(4);\n        var cleanupError = new InvalidOperationException(\"cleanup boom\");\n        observer.CleanupFailed(\"01-alpha\", cleanupError);\n        observer.PromptPaused(task, \"rate limited\", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), 1);\n\n        Assert.Equal(\n            new[]\n            {\n                \"AttemptStarting:01-alpha:2:3\",\n                \"PlanHashMismatch:sha256:deadbeef\",\n                \"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:4\",\n                \"CleanupFailed:01-alpha:cleanup boom\",\n                \"PromptPaused:01-alpha:rate limited:30:1\",\n            },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ARenderFailure_IsSwallowed_AndDoesNotThrow()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n\n        // An invalid output path (a directory that does not exist, never created) simulates the\n        // render/write step failing on disk — mirrors OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver's documented\n        // best-effort behavior: a render failure must never propagate out of an observer event.\n        string badPath = Path.Combine(fixture.Root, \"does-not-exist\", \"nested\", \"diagram.html\");\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, [task], badPath, MermaidSource, SourceHash, fixture.TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        Exception? thrown = Record.Exception(() => observer.TaskStarting(task));\n        Assert.Null(thrown);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Records the identity/arguments of every forwarded pass-through event.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n            Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}:{result.Name}\");\n\n        public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n            Events.Add($\"AttemptStarting:{task.Id}:{attempt}:{budget}\");\n\n        public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PlanHashMismatch:{previousPlanHash}\");\n\n        public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) =>\n            Events.Add($\"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:{requested}\");\n\n        public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) =>\n            Events.Add($\"CleanupFailed:{owner}:{error.Message}\");\n\n        public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PromptPaused:{task.Id}:{reason}:{(int)backoff.TotalSeconds}:{pauseCount}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway plan dir with helpers to build fixtures and read the rendered diagram.</summary>\n    private sealed class DiagramFixture : IDisposable\n    {\n        public string Root { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otfd-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string DiagramHtmlPath => Path.Combine(Root, \"diagram.html\");\n\n        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets { get; } =\n            new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_alpha\"] = \"tasks/01-alpha/\" };\n\n        public DiagramFixture() => Directory.CreateDirectory(Root);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id, params string[] guardrailNames)\n        {\n            IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> guardrails = guardrailNames.Length == 0\n                ? Driven directly against the\n/// decorator (no real Scheduler) — a focused unit test of the projection logic and of the\n/// pass-through of every other <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> event.\n/// </summary>\n/// <remarks>\n/// The decorator is currently a STUB (03-author-tests-diagram-observer): its render/write step\n/// throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> unconditionally. Every test below that triggers a\n/// render is expected to FAIL against that stub — this is the intended TDD RED that\n/// 04-implement-diagram-observer turns green. <see cref=\"EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged\"/>\n/// touches no rendering path, so it is expected to pass even against the stub.\n/// </remarks>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests\n{\n    private const string MermaidSource = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_01_alpha[\\\"01-alpha\\\"]:::task\\n\";\n    private const string SourceHash = \"abc123\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void TaskStarting_RerendersDiagramWithTheTaskMarkedRunning()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(task);\n\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"running\", statuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void GuardrailFinished_RerendersDiagramWithThatChecksSettledStatus()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\", \"01-x\", \"02-y\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> afterPass = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", afterPass.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_0\"));\n        // Only that specific check's node flips — not the whole task container.\n        Assert.Equal(\"pending\", afterPass.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"02-y\", Passed = false });\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> afterFail = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(\"failed\", afterFail.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_1\"));\n        // The first check's settled status is untouched by the second check finishing.\n        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", afterFail.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha_gr_0\"));\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.Succeeded, \"passed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.GuardrailFailed, \"failed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman, \"needs-human\")]\n    public void TaskFinished_RerendersDiagramWithTheTasksSettledStatus(TaskOutcome outcome, string expectedStatus)\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskFinished(new TaskResult { TaskId = \"01-alpha\", Outcome = outcome, Summary = \"done\" });\n\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses = fixture.ReadNodeStatuses();\n        Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, statuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_alpha\"));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n        var observer = fixture.MakeObserver(inner, [task]);\n\n        observer.AttemptStarting(task, 2, 3);\n        observer.PlanHashMismatch(\"sha256:deadbeef\");\n        observer.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(4);\n        var cleanupError = new InvalidOperationException(\"cleanup boom\");\n        observer.CleanupFailed(\"01-alpha\", cleanupError);\n        observer.PromptPaused(task, \"rate limited\", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), 1);\n\n        Assert.Equal(\n            new[]\n            {\n                \"AttemptStarting:01-alpha:2:3\",\n                \"PlanHashMismatch:sha256:deadbeef\",\n                \"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:4\",\n                \"CleanupFailed:01-alpha:cleanup boom\",\n                \"PromptPaused:01-alpha:rate limited:30:1\",\n            },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ARenderFailure_IsSwallowed_AndDoesNotThrow()\n    {\n        using var fixture = new DiagramFixture();\n        TaskNode task = fixture.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n\n        // An invalid output path (a directory that does not exist, never created) simulates the\n        // render/write step failing on disk — mirrors OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver's documented\n        // best-effort behavior: a render failure must never propagate out of an observer event.\n        string badPath = Path.Combine(fixture.Root, \"does-not-exist\", \"nested\", \"diagram.html\");\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, [task], badPath, MermaidSource, SourceHash, fixture.TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        Exception? thrown = Record.Exception(() => observer.TaskStarting(task));\n        Assert.Null(thrown);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Records the identity/arguments of every forwarded pass-through event.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n            Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}:{result.Name}\");\n\n        public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n            Events.Add($\"AttemptStarting:{task.Id}:{attempt}:{budget}\");\n\n        public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PlanHashMismatch:{previousPlanHash}\");\n\n        public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) =>\n            Events.Add($\"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:{requested}\");\n\n        public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) =>\n            Events.Add($\"CleanupFailed:{owner}:{error.Message}\");\n\n        public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PromptPaused:{task.Id}:{reason}:{(int)backoff.TotalSeconds}:{pauseCount}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway plan dir with TaskFolderTargets { get; } =\n            new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_alpha\"] = \"tasks/01-alpha/\" };\n\n        public DiagramFixture() => Directory.CreateDirectory(Root);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id, params string[] guardrailNames)\n        {\n            IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> guardrails = guardrailNames.Length == 0\n                ? [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }]\n                : guardrailNames\n                    .Select(name => new GuardrailDefinition { Name = name, Path = $\"{name}.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script })\n                    .ToList();\n\n            return new TaskNode\n            {\n                Id = id,\n                Directory = Path.Combine(Root, \"tasks\", id),\n                Description = \"task \" + id,\n                Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n                Guardrails = guardrails,\n            };\n        }\n\n        public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver MakeObserver(IRunObserver inner, IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks) =>\n            new(inner, tasks, DiagramHtmlPath, MermaidSource, SourceHash, TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> ReadNodeStatuses()\n        {\n            string html = File.ReadAllText(DiagramHtmlPath);\n            const string marker = \"<script type=\\\"application/json\\\" id=\\\"node-statuses\\\">\";\n            int start = html.IndexOf(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n            Assert.True(start >= 0, \"diagram.html has no #node-statuses side-table\");\n\n            start += marker.Length;\n            int end = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", start, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n            Assert.True(end >= 0, \"malformed #node-statuses script tag in diagram.html\");\n\n            string json = html[start..end];\n            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(json) ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();\n        }\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Root, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

**Scope boundary (harness-enforced):** Write only to
`tests/Guardrails.Integration.Tests/OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests.cs` and
`src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs` (the new stub file). After this task

paths. An out-of-scope edit fails the task immediately and consumes a retry. If you hit

write `{"needsHuman": "<what is missing>"}` to the state-out path and stop.

### Background

`src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver.cs` is an existing, working decorator
`IRunObserver` — read it in full before starting; the new class mirrors its exact shape.
It wraps a real observer (`_inner`), forwards every `IRunObserver` event to it, and after
forwarding certain events re-renders a live artifact from an in-memory per-task status
map, serialized under one `lock (_gate)` object, with renders wrapped best-effort (a
render failure never flips a task's outcome — see its private `TryRender` helper).

`IRunObserver` (`src/Guardrails.Core/Execution/IRunObserver.cs`) exposes: `TaskStarting`,
`AttemptStarting`, `TaskFinished`, `GuardrailFinished`, `PlanHashMismatch`,
`ParallelismClampedNoProvider`, `CleanupFailed`, `PromptPaused`.

`02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer` (already landed) added a `nodeStatuses`
parameter to `HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(mermaidSource, sourceHash, taskFolderTargets,
nodeStatuses)` — when non-null, it emits the live status overlay + refresh meta tag this
new observer will call into.

### What to build (tests + stubs only — no real implementation)

Create `src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs`, a new `sealed class
OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver` in namespace `Guardrails.Cli.Ui`, mirroring
`OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s shape exactly:

- Constructor takes (at minimum) the inner `IRunObserver` to wrap, the plan's
  `IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks`, the path to write `diagram.html` to, and whatever
  Mermaid-source/hash/task-folder-targets `HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render` needs to
  re-render (thread these through however is cleanest — you may need to read the
  ALREADY-WRITTEN `diagram.html`'s embedded `<script type="text/plain"
  id="graph-source">` / `<script type="application/json" id="task-folder-targets">`
  content back out to get the Mermaid source + targets map for re-rendering, since the
  observer does not have direct access to the `PlanDefinition` the CLI's `graph` command
  used to generate it originally — OR thread those two values in via the constructor;
  pick whichever is simpler and state your choice).
- On `TaskStarting`: flip that task's node status to `"running"` (and its preflight/
  guardrail leaf ids, if you track per-check granularity at this stage — the coarser
  per-task-only version is acceptable for THIS task; per-check granularity can also be
  driven by `GuardrailFinished`, see below), forward to `_inner`, then re-render
  `diagram.html` under the lock (best-effort — swallow a render failure).
- On `GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)`: flip that specific
  check's node id to `"passed"` or `"failed"` per `result`, forward, re-render.
- On `TaskFinished(TaskResult result)`: flip the task's node status to its settled
  outcome (`"passed"` / `"failed"` / `"needs-human"`, mapped from `result.Outcome`),
  forward, re-render.
- Every other `IRunObserver` member: forward to `_inner` unchanged (no status-map
  involvement) — mirror `OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s pass-through members exactly.
- Write the MINIMAL stub: the class and constructor compile with the right shape, but
  the render call can `throw new NotImplementedException()` — this task's job is
  failing tests, not the real implementation.

### Tests to write

In `tests/Guardrails.Integration.Tests/OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests.cs` (xUnit — this
repo's existing framework), construct a real `OnTheFlyDiagramObserver` wrapping a fake/
no-op `IRunObserver`, fire `TaskStarting`/`GuardrailFinished`/`TaskFinished` against it
directly (no real Scheduler needed — this is a focused unit test of the decorator
itself), and assert on the resulting `diagram.html` FILE CONTENTS written to a temp
directory:

- `TaskStarting_RerendersDiagramWithTheTaskMarkedRunning` — after firing
  `TaskStarting`, the written `diagram.html` contains a `"running"` status entry for
  that task's node id.
- `GuardrailFinished_RerendersDiagramWithThatChecksSettledStatus` — a passed vs a
  failed `GuardrailResult` produces `"passed"`/`"failed"` for that check's node id
  specifically (not the whole task).
- `TaskFinished_RerendersDiagramWithTheTasksSettledStatus`.
- `EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged` — a spy/fake inner observer
  records that each pass-through event was forwarded exactly once with the same
  arguments.
- `ARenderFailure_IsSwallowed_AndDoesNotThrow` — simulate a render failure (e.g. an
  invalid output path) and assert firing an event does not throw (best-effort, mirroring
  `OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s documented behavior).

These must compile and FAIL against the throwing stub — that failure IS the TDD red
`04-implement-diagram-observer` turns green.

            $tokens = $rest -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
            $i = 0
            $wtPath = $null
            while ($i -lt $tokens.Count) {
                $t = $tokens[$i]
                if ($t.StartsWith('-')) {
                    if ($t -eq '-b' -or $t -eq '-B') { $i++ }
                    $i++
                    continue
                }
                $wtPath = $t
                break
            }
            Resolve-AndCheck $wtPath
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)git\s+checkout\s.*--\s+(?<rest>.+)$') {
            $rest = $Matches['rest']
            foreach ($p in ($rest -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })) {
                Resolve-AndCheck $p
            }
        }

        $redirMatches = [regex]::Matches($cmd, '>>?\s*([^\s&|;]+)')
        if ($redirMatches.Count -gt 0) {
            Resolve-AndCheck $redirMatches[$redirMatches.Count - 1].Groups[1].Value
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)tee\s+(-a\s+)?(?<p>[^\s&|;]+)') {
            Resolve-AndCheck $Matches['p']
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)(cp|mv)\s+(?<args>.+)$') {
            $cpArgs = $Matches['args'] -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
            if ($cpArgs.Count -gt 0) {
                Resolve-AndCheck $cpArgs[$cpArgs.Count - 1]
            }
        }
    }
}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Xo5cCL2EjyqfiXkYd6qhCU","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\n2\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n3\t\n4\tnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n5\t\n6\t/// <summary>\n7\t/// A decorator <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> that keeps the DURING-RUN static log site\n8\t/// (<c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> + per-task pages) up to date as the run proceeds (issue #141\n9\t/// item 2). It WRAPS the real observer (live <see cref=\"LiveRunObserver\"/> or\n10\t/// <see cref=\"ConsoleRunObserver\"/>), forwards every event verbatim, and AFTER forwarding rewrites\n11\t/// the site through <see cref=\"LogSiteRenderer\"/>:\n12\t/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n13\t///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/> a task flips pending → running and the index is rewritten —\n14\t///     a running task links to the LIVE server (a click tails it) when a server is up, else plain text.</item>\n15\t///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> a task flips to its settled status, its static page is written\n16\t///     (<see cref=\"LogSiteRenderer.WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts\"/>), and the index is rewritten — a\n17\t///     settled task with attempts on disk now links to its static page.</item>\n18\t/// </list>\n19\t///\n20\t/// <para>The index always carries the <c>meta refresh</c> (<c>includeRefresh:true</c>) so a\n21\t/// <c>file://</c> view re-reads it as it is rewritten; the DURABLE final/<c>--export</c> index (no\n22\t/// refresh, all-static) is written separately by the run's end-of-run path, NOT here.</para>\n23\t///\n24\t/// <para>The renderer writes atomically, so a browser never reads a torn file. This decorator's own\n25\t/// status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads call in concurrently, so all\n26\t/// access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under one lock. Renders are\n27\t/// best-effort: a render failure (e.g. a transient file lock) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n28\t/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.</para>\n29\t/// </summary>\n30\tpublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver : IRunObserver\n31\t{\n32\t    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n33\t    private readonly string _logsRoot;\n34\t    private readonly string _runId;\n35\t    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> _tasks;\n36\t    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n37\t    private readonly Func<string, string?>? _liveUrlForTask;\n38\t\n39\t    // Per-task status word, seeded \"pending\". Mutated and projected under one lock — events arrive\n40\t    // from concurrent M4 workers, and the index render reads the whole map, so the two must not race.\n41\t    private readonly object _gate = new();\n42\t    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByTask;\n43\t\n44\t    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n45\t    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the site is written into.</param>\n46\t    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n47\t    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n48\t    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">\n49\t    /// Resolver mapping a task id to its live-server URL, or null when no server is up. A RUNNING task\n50\t    /// links to this URL (a click tails it) when non-null; null = the running task is plain text.\n51\t    /// </param>\n52\t    public OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n53\t        IRunObserver inner,\n54\t        string logsRoot,\n55\t        string runId,\n56\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n57\t        Func<string, string?>? liveUrlForTask)\n58\t    {\n59\t        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n60\t        _logsRoot = logsRoot;\n61\t        _runId = runId;\n62\t        _tasks = tasks;\n63\t        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n64\t        _liveUrlForTask = liveUrlForTask;\n65\t        _statusByTask = tasks.ToDictionary(\n66\t            t => t.Id, _ => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Pending), StringComparer.Ordinal);\n67\t    }\n68\t\n69\t    /// <summary>\n70\t    /// Write the initial all-pending index at run start (every task pending, plain text), so the \"all\n71\t    /// tasks\" page exists and is browsable the moment the run begins. Best-effort. Delegates to the\n72\t    /// static <see cref=\"WriteInitialIndex(string, string, IReadOnlyList{TaskNode}, Func{string, string?})\"/>.\n73\t    /// </summary>\n74\t    public void WriteInitialIndex() => WriteInitialIndex(_logsRoot, _runId, _tasks, _liveUrlForTask);\n75\t\n76\t    /// <summary>\n77\t    /// Write the initial all-pending index (every task <c>pending</c>, plain link, with the during-run\n78\t    /// meta-refresh) WITHOUT an observer instance, so the live path can write it — and print the\n79\t    /// link to it — BEFORE constructing <see cref=\"LiveRunObserver\"/> (which starts the Spectre\n80\t    /// <c>AnsiConsole.Live</c> region in its ctor). Any console write into an active Live region\n81\t    /// corrupts the table, so the initial index + its static-index link must be emitted first (#145\n82\t    /// Bug 1). Best-effort: a render failure is swallowed (a UX nicety never aborts the run).\n83\t    /// </summary>\n84\t    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the index is written into.</param>\n85\t    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n86\t    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n87\t    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">Unused at the all-pending start (no task is running yet); accepted\n88\t    /// so the static signature matches the instance's link-resolution surface for callers.</param>\n89\t    public static void WriteInitialIndex(\n90\t        string logsRoot,\n91\t        string runId,\n92\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n93\t        Func<string, string?>? liveUrlForTask)\n94\t    {\n95\t        _ = liveUrlForTask; // no task is running at the all-pending start, so no live link is resolved yet\n96\t        string pending = LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Pending);\n97\t        TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n98\t            logsRoot,\n99\t            runId,\n100\t            tasks,\n101\t            statusResolver: _ => pending,\n102\t            linkResolver: _ => LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain,\n103\t            includeRefresh: true));\n104\t    }\n105\t\n106\t    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n107\t    {\n108\t        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n109\t        SetStatus(task.Id, LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running));\n110\t        RenderIndex();\n111\t    }\n112\t\n113\t    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n114\t        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n115\t\n116\t    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n117\t        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n118\t\n119\t    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n120\t    {\n121\t        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n122\t        SetStatus(result.TaskId, StatusWord(result.Outcome));\n123\t\n124\t        // Write the finished task's static page so the index's link to it (and the terminal's\n125\t        // post-mortem link, #141 item 1) resolves to a rendered page, not a 404.\n126\t        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n127\t        {\n128\t            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(_logsRoot, task));\n129\t        }\n130\t\n131\t        RenderIndex();\n132\t    }\n133\t\n134\t    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n135\t\n136\t    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n137\t\n138\t    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n139\t\n140\t    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n141\t        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n142\t\n143\t    // --- site projection --------------------------------------------------------------------\n144\t\n145\t    private void SetStatus(string taskId, string status)\n146\t    {\n147\t        lock (_gate)\n148\t        {\n149\t            _statusByTask[taskId] = status;\n150\t        }\n151\t    }\n152\t\n153\t    /// <summary>\n154\t    /// Rewrite the during-run index (with refresh) from the current status map. Holds the lock for the\n155\t    /// whole render so the status snapshot and the link choice are consistent (the renderer writes\n156\t    /// atomically). The link resolver: a RUNNING task → the live URL when a server is up (else plain),\n157\t    /// any task with attempts on disk → its static page, anything else → plain text.\n158\t    /// </summary>\n159\t    private void RenderIndex()\n160\t    {\n161\t        lock (_gate)\n162\t        {\n163\t            // Snapshot the statuses inside the lock so the resolver closures read a stable view.\n164\t            var statuses = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByTask, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n165\t            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n166\t                _logsRoot,\n167\t                _runId,\n168\t                _tasks,\n169\t                statusResolver: id => statuses.TryGetValue(id, out string? s) ? s : \"unknown\",\n170\t                linkResolver: id => ResolveLink(id, statuses),\n171\t                includeRefresh: true));\n172\t        }\n173\t    }\n174\t\n175\t    private LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink ResolveLink(string taskId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses)\n176\t    {\n177\t        bool running = statuses.TryGetValue(taskId, out string? status) &&\n178\t                       status == LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running);\n179\t\n180\t        // A running task links to the live server (a click tails it) when one is up; otherwise it is\n181\t        // plain text (no static page to point at yet).\n182\t        if (running && _liveUrlForTask?.Invoke(taskId) is { } liveUrl)\n183\t        {\n184\t            return LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.LiveTo(liveUrl);\n185\t        }\n186\t\n187\t        // A task with attempts on disk (running-without-server, or settled) links to its static page;\n188\t        // a pending/no-attempt task is plain text.\n189\t        return HasAttempts(taskId) ? LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Static : LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain;\n190\t    }\n191\t\n192\t    private bool HasAttempts(string taskId)\n193\t    {\n194\t        string taskDir = Path.Combine(_logsRoot, taskId);\n195\t        if (!Directory.Exists(taskDir))\n196\t        {\n197\t            return false;\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(taskDir)\n201\t            .Any(d => Path.GetFileName(d).StartsWith(\"attempt-\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n202\t    }\n203\t\n204\t    /// <summary>Map a finished task's outcome to the index status word (mirrors the journal mapping).</summary>\n205\t    private static string StatusWord(TaskOutcome outcome) => outcome switch\n206\t    {\n207\t        TaskOutcome.Succeeded => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded),\n208\t        TaskOutcome.Skipped => \"skipped\",\n209\t        TaskOutcome.Blocked => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Blocked),\n210\t        TaskOutcome.Cancelled => \"cancelled\",\n211\t        // ActionFailed / GuardrailFailed / InvalidFragment / NeedsHuman are all needs-human terminal.\n212\t        _ => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.NeedsHuman),\n213\t    };\n214\t\n215\t    /// <summary>\n216\t    /// Run a render action, swallowing IO failures: the on-the-fly site is a UX nicety and must never\n217\t    /// flip a task's outcome or abort the run. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the next event.\n218\t    /// </summary>\n219\t    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n220\t    {\n221\t        try\n222\t        {\n223\t            render();\n224\t        }\n225\t        catch (IOException)\n226\t        {\n227\t            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n228\t        }\n229\t        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n230\t        {\n231\t            // best-effort — never let a logs-tree permission hiccup abort the run\n232\t        }\n233\t    }\n234\t}\n235\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b082e741-5793-429b-be34-e97726bd8b3f","uuid":"390a0cc6-593f-4cd7-ab59-8398b6a62823","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:41:17.954Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Cli\\Ui\\OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// A decorator <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> that keeps the DURING-RUN static log site\n/// (<c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> + per-task pages) up to date as the run proceeds (issue #141\n/// item 2). It WRAPS the real observer (live <see cref=\"LiveRunObserver\"/> or\n/// <see cref=\"ConsoleRunObserver\"/>), forwards every event verbatim, and AFTER forwarding rewrites\n/// the site through <see cref=\"LogSiteRenderer\"/>:\n/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/> a task flips pending → running and the index is rewritten —\n///     a running task links to the LIVE server (a click tails it) when a server is up, else plain text.</item>\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> a task flips to its settled status, its static page is written\n///     (<see cref=\"LogSiteRenderer.WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts\"/>), and the index is rewritten — a\n///     settled task with attempts on disk now links to its static page.</item>\n/// </list>\n///\n/// <para>The index always carries the <c>meta refresh</c> (<c>includeRefresh:true</c>) so a\n/// <c>file://</c> view re-reads it as it is rewritten; the DURABLE final/<c>--export</c> index (no\n/// refresh, all-static) is written separately by the run's end-of-run path, NOT here.</para>\n///\n/// <para>The renderer writes atomically, so a browser never reads a torn file. This decorator's own\n/// status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads call in concurrently, so all\n/// access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under one lock. Renders are\n/// best-effort: a render failure (e.g. a transient file lock) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.</para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly string _logsRoot;\n    private readonly string _runId;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> _tasks;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly Func<string, string?>? _liveUrlForTask;\n\n    // Per-task status word, seeded \"pending\". Mutated and projected under one lock — events arrive\n    // from concurrent M4 workers, and the index render reads the whole map, so the two must not race.\n    private readonly object _gate = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByTask;\n\n    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the site is written into.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">\n    /// Resolver mapping a task id to its live-server URL, or null when no server is up. A RUNNING task\n    /// links to this URL (a click tails it) when non-null; null = the running task is plain text.\n    /// </param>\n    public OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n        IRunObserver inner,\n        string logsRoot,\n        string runId,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        Func<string, string?>? liveUrlForTask)\n    {\n        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n        _logsRoot = logsRoot;\n        _runId = runId;\n        _tasks = tasks;\n        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        _liveUrlForTask = liveUrlForTask;\n        _statusByTask = tasks.ToDictionary(\n            t => t.Id, _ => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Pending), StringComparer.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Write the initial all-pending index at run start (every task pending, plain text), so the \"all\n    /// tasks\" page exists and is browsable the moment the run begins. Best-effort. Delegates to the\n    /// static <see cref=\"WriteInitialIndex(string, string, IReadOnlyList{TaskNode}, Func{string, string?})\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    public void WriteInitialIndex() => WriteInitialIndex(_logsRoot, _runId, _tasks, _liveUrlForTask);\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Write the initial all-pending index (every task <c>pending</c>, plain link, with the during-run\n    /// meta-refresh) WITHOUT an observer instance, so the live path can write it — and print the\n    /// link to it — BEFORE constructing <see cref=\"LiveRunObserver\"/> (which starts the Spectre\n    /// <c>AnsiConsole.Live</c> region in its ctor). Any console write into an active Live region\n    /// corrupts the table, so the initial index + its static-index link must be emitted first (#145\n    /// Bug 1). Best-effort: a render failure is swallowed (a UX nicety never aborts the run).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the index is written into.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">Unused at the all-pending start (no task is running yet); accepted\n    /// so the static signature matches the instance's link-resolution surface for callers.</param>\n    public static void WriteInitialIndex(\n        string logsRoot,\n        string runId,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        Func<string, string?>? liveUrlForTask)\n    {\n        _ = liveUrlForTask; // no task is running at the all-pending start, so no live link is resolved yet\n        string pending = LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Pending);\n        TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n            logsRoot,\n            runId,\n            tasks,\n            statusResolver: _ => pending,\n            linkResolver: _ => LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain,\n            includeRefresh: true));\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(task.Id, LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running));\n        RenderIndex();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n        SetStatus(result.TaskId, StatusWord(result.Outcome));\n\n        // Write the finished task's static page so the index's link to it (and the terminal's\n        // post-mortem link, #141 item 1) resolves to a rendered page, not a 404.\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n        {\n            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(_logsRoot, task));\n        }\n\n        RenderIndex();\n    }\n\n    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n\n    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n\n    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n\n    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n\n    // --- site projection --------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void SetStatus(string taskId, string status)\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            _statusByTask[taskId] = status;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Rewrite the during-run index (with refresh) from the current status map. Holds the lock for the\n    /// whole render so the status snapshot and the link choice are consistent (the renderer writes\n    /// atomically). The link resolver: a RUNNING task → the live URL when a server is up (else plain),\n    /// any task with attempts on disk → its static page, anything else → plain text.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void RenderIndex()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            // Snapshot the statuses inside the lock so the resolver closures read a stable view.\n            var statuses = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByTask, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n                _logsRoot,\n                _runId,\n                _tasks,\n                statusResolver: id => statuses.TryGetValue(id, out string? s) ? s : \"unknown\",\n                linkResolver: id => ResolveLink(id, statuses),\n                includeRefresh: true));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink ResolveLink(string taskId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses)\n    {\n        bool running = statuses.TryGetValue(taskId, out string? status) &&\n                       status == LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running);\n\n        // A running task links to the live server (a click tails it) when one is up; otherwise it is\n        // plain text (no static page to point at yet).\n        if (running && _liveUrlForTask?.Invoke(taskId) is { } liveUrl)\n        {\n            return LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.LiveTo(liveUrl);\n        }\n\n        // A task with attempts on disk (running-without-server, or settled) links to its static page;\n        // a pending/no-attempt task is plain text.\n        return HasAttempts(taskId) ? LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Static : LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain;\n    }\n\n    private bool HasAttempts(string taskId)\n    {\n        string taskDir = Path.Combine(_logsRoot, taskId);\n        if (!Directory.Exists(taskDir))\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(taskDir)\n            .Any(d => Path.GetFileName(d).StartsWith(\"attempt-\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Map a finished task's outcome to the index status word (mirrors the journal mapping).</summary>\n    private static string StatusWord(TaskOutcome outcome) => outcome switch\n    {\n        TaskOutcome.Succeeded => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded),\n        TaskOutcome.Skipped => \"skipped\",\n        TaskOutcome.Blocked => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Blocked),\n        TaskOutcome.Cancelled => \"cancelled\",\n        // ActionFailed / GuardrailFailed / InvalidFragment / NeedsHuman are all needs-human terminal.\n        _ => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.NeedsHuman),\n    };\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Run a render action, swallowing IO failures: the on-the-fly site is a UX nicety and must never\n    /// flip a task's outcome or abort the run. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the next event.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a logs-tree permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":235,"startLine":1,"totalLines":235}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XCcGYheLRKDTGjyoHydwhu","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing System.Text.Encodings.Web;\n2\tusing System.Text.Json;\n3\t\n4\tnamespace Guardrails.Core.Graph;\n5\t\n6\t/// <summary>\n7\t/// Renders the local-viewing companion to <c>diagram.md</c>: a self-contained\n8\t/// <c>diagram.html</c> that displays the SAME Mermaid DAG with pan / zoom / fullscreen, so a\n9\t/// large task+guardrail graph is actually navigable on disk (GitHub renders <c>diagram.md</c>\n10\t/// but offers no navigation). Pure: maps the rendered Mermaid text + its <c>source-sha256</c>\n11\t/// to an HTML string with no I/O (issue #33).\n12\t/// </summary>\n13\t/// <remarks>\n14\t/// <para>\n15\t/// The Mermaid source is embedded VERBATIM as the text content of a\n16\t/// <c>&lt;script type=\"text/plain\"&gt;</c> element and read back via <c>textContent</c> — never\n17\t/// interpolated into a JS string. This sidesteps every escaping hazard (a label containing a\n18\t/// backtick, <c>${</c>, or a quote cannot break the page), and a <c>&lt;script&gt;</c> element's\n19\t/// content is \"raw text\" so entities are not decoded — the source round-trips byte-for-byte.\n20\t/// This is safe because <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> HTML-escapes every label (so <c>&lt;</c>\n21\t/// becomes <c>&amp;lt;</c>), meaning the source can never contain <c>&lt;/script&gt;</c>.\n22\t/// </para>\n23\t/// <para>\n24\t/// The <c>source-sha256</c> provenance comment is emitted as the FIRST line (before\n25\t/// <c>&lt;!doctype html&gt;</c>) so the same <c>\\A</c>-anchored reader that validates\n26\t/// <c>diagram.md</c> validates this file too (<c>graph --check</c>). A comment before the\n27\t/// doctype does not trigger quirks mode.\n28\t/// </para>\n29\t/// <para>\n30\t/// The renderer (Mermaid) and pan-zoom library load from a CDN, so the interactive view needs\n31\t/// internet the first time. GitHub will not execute the embedded script — this file is the\n32\t/// LOCAL artifact; <c>diagram.md</c> remains the portal artifact. Fully offline (inlined assets)\n33\t/// is a possible follow-up.\n34\t/// </para>\n35\t/// <para>\n36\t/// <b>Legend overlay.</b> A corner-anchored <c>#legend</c> <c>&lt;div&gt;</c>\n37\t/// (<c>position: fixed</c>), mirroring the existing <c>#bar</c>/<c>#hint</c> overlay divs, renders\n38\t/// <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.LegendMarkdown\"/>'s content OUTSIDE the Mermaid SVG. A Mermaid-native\n39\t/// legend (a disconnected subgraph of colour-swatch nodes) was prototyped and rendered BROKEN —\n40\t/// dagre lays out a disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\" overlapping the real DAG — so\n41\t/// the overlay div is the only approach that renders correctly. Static HTML, not templated from\n42\t/// the Mermaid source, so it carries no bearing on <c>source-sha256</c>.\n43\t/// </para>\n44\t/// <para>\n45\t/// <b>Task-container click target: a POST-RENDER SVG title-band overlay (issue #232/#233\n46\t/// superseded, issue #235).</b> A Mermaid <c>click</c> directive never fires on a subgraph/cluster\n47\t/// element (upstream limitation; see <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> remarks), and the first fix\n48\t/// attempt — an invisible anchor NODE inside the container — proved useless in practice: dagre\n49\t/// sizes and packs it into whatever gap its own layout leaves, which for a content-dense container\n50\t/// is a tiny, off-center sliver (measured: 0.44% of the container's area on a real 4-guardrail\n51\t/// task). The fix implemented here instead runs AFTER <c>mermaid.render</c> resolves: for every\n52\t/// <c>g.cluster</c> element whose id starts with <c>task_</c>, compute a full-width band from the\n53\t/// cluster's own bounding box down to just past its <c>.cluster-label</c>'s bottom edge (Mermaid\n54\t/// always reserves this header strip above any leaf content, so it is empty BY CONSTRUCTION\n55\t/// regardless of how many guardrails/preflights the task has — unlike an interior anchor node) and\n56\t/// append a real <c>&lt;a href=\"...\" target=\"_blank\"&gt;&lt;rect fill=\"transparent\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;</c>\n57\t/// spanning it. APPENDED, not inserted first: a cluster's only two original children are its\n58\t/// background <c>&lt;rect&gt;</c> then its <c>.cluster-label</c> group, so appending puts the\n59\t/// overlay last in paint order (on top, clickable) without moving in front of the label text\n60\t/// visually (the rect is transparent) and — because every leaf check node lives in an entirely\n61\t/// separate top-level SVG group from its own container's <c>g.cluster</c> — the overlay can never\n62\t/// occlude or be occluded by a leaf node's own click target either way. The task→folder-path data\n63\t/// this script needs (<see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>) is embedded as a small JSON\n64\t/// object keyed by the SAME container id the Mermaid source uses, in a\n65\t/// <c>&lt;script type=\"application/json\"&gt;</c> element read back via <c>textContent</c> (same\n66\t/// verbatim/never-interpolated treatment as the Mermaid source itself, immune to the same escaping\n67\t/// hazards).\n68\t/// </para>\n69\t/// <para>\n70\t/// <b>Long task-name title wrap-overflow, fixed by widening the label's foreignObject\n71\t/// post-render (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow).</b> Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title\n72\t/// <c>&lt;div&gt;</c> to a hardcoded 200px width (the bundled <c>mermaid@11.4.1</c>'s plain\n73\t/// flowchart cluster shape never overrides <c>createText</c>'s <c>width = 200</c> default,\n74\t/// regardless of the container's own — usually much wider — computed width), and dagre's layout\n75\t/// pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that wrapped height is known, so a\n76\t/// long kebab-case task name (hyphens are valid soft line-break points) that wraps to 2+ lines\n77\t/// prints past the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box positioned\n78\t/// directly below. No Mermaid config knob avoids this — <c>flowchart.htmlLabels</c> only toggles\n79\t/// the html-vs-svg-text label renderer, and 11.4.1 has no documented option for cluster-label\n80\t/// wrap width. The fix (the <c>fixWrappedClusterLabels</c> function, run AFTER\n81\t/// <c>mermaid.render</c> resolves and BEFORE the title-band overlay above, since the overlay's\n82\t/// band height depends on the label's — by then possibly shrunk — bounding box) re-wraps the\n83\t/// SAME text at up to the container's own width instead: since the container is normally already\n84\t/// wider than 200px, this almost always drops the label to one line, which needs LESS height than\n85\t/// the original wrap — never more — so no other node/edge/container ever needs to move. Verified\n86\t/// headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names): every wrapped case converged to one line\n87\t/// with the same healthy gap a never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label\n88\t/// (including the whole golden <c>hello-guardrails</c> example) was left byte-for-byte unchanged.\n89\t/// </para>\n90\t/// </remarks>\n91\tpublic static class HtmlDiagramRenderer\n92\t{\n93\t    /// <summary>\n94\t    /// Build the <c>diagram.html</c> document for <paramref name=\"mermaidSource\"/> (the exact\n95\t    /// text rendered into <c>diagram.md</c>, including the <c>flowchart TD</c> header and the\n96\t    /// cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines) stamped with <paramref name=\"sourceHash\"/>. <paramref\n97\t    /// name=\"taskFolderTargets\"/> is the task-container-id → plan-relative-folder-path map (see\n98\t    /// <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>) the embedded title-band overlay script uses\n99\t    /// to resolve each container's click target (issue #235 — see class remarks).\n100\t    /// </summary>\n101\t    /// <param name=\"nodeStatuses\">\n102\t    /// OPTIONAL live-run status map (issue #219): Mermaid node/container id → one of\n103\t    /// <c>\"pending\"</c>, <c>\"running\"</c>, <c>\"passed\"</c>, <c>\"failed\"</c>, <c>\"needs-human\"</c>,\n104\t    /// keyed by the SAME ids <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> emits (task containers <c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>,\n105\t    /// preflight/guardrail leaves <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_pf_&lt;n&gt;</c>/<c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;n&gt;</c>,\n106\t    /// and the plan-level brackets <c>plan_preflights</c>/<c>plan_guardrails</c>). When non-null the\n107\t    /// document additionally carries a per-node status-overlay badge (an animated spinner while\n108\t    /// <c>running</c>, a settled check/X/\"?\" glyph once finished). When <c>null</c> (the static\n109\t    /// <c>graph</c> command, which never runs live) the output is byte-identical to the pre-#219\n110\t    /// three-argument render.\n111\t    /// </param>\n112\t    /// <param name=\"includeRefresh\">\n113\t    /// INDEPENDENT of the status overlay (mirrors <c>LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)</c>):\n114\t    /// when <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> is non-null AND this is <c>true</c> (the default,\n115\t    /// the DURING-RUN diagram) a <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"2\"&gt;</c> is emitted so a\n116\t    /// plain <c>file://</c> view re-reads itself as the run progresses; when <c>false</c> (the FINAL\n117\t    /// settled render wired at run-end by <c>06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand</c>) the overlay\n118\t    /// is still emitted but the refresh tag is not. Ignored when <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> is null.\n119\t    /// </param>\n120\t    public static string Render(\n121\t        string mermaidSource, string sourceHash, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> taskFolderTargets,\n122\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? nodeStatuses = null, bool includeRefresh = true)\n123\t    {\n124\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(mermaidSource);\n125\t        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(sourceHash);\n126\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(taskFolderTargets);\n127\t\n128\t        // Newline-normalize so the file is byte-identical across OSes (mirrors the renderer/hash).\n129\t        string source = mermaidSource\n130\t            .Replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n131\t            .Replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n132\t            .TrimEnd('\\n');\n133\t\n134\t        // Encoder that escapes NOTHING beyond what JSON strictly requires (default System.Text.Json\n135\t        // escapes '<', '>', '&', etc. as \\uXXXX for HTML safety, which is unnecessary here — the\n136\t        // JSON sits inside a <script type=\"application/json\"> element, read back via textContent,\n137\t        // exactly like the Mermaid source above — but using the unsafe-relaxed encoder keeps a\n138\t        // task-id containing e.g. \"&\" readable in the raw HTML source without changing behavior).\n139\t        string targetsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(taskFolderTargets, new JsonSerializerOptions\n140\t        {\n141\t            Encoder = JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping,\n142\t        });\n143\t\n144\t        string html = Template\n145\t            .Replace(\"__SOURCE_SHA256__\", sourceHash, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n146\t            .Replace(\"__GRAPH_SOURCE__\", source, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n147\t            .Replace(\"__TASK_FOLDER_TARGETS__\", targetsJson, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n148\t\n149\t        // Live-run status overlay (issue #219) is OPTIONAL: when nodeStatuses is null (the static\n150\t        // `graph` command, which never runs live) the template is emitted UNCHANGED, so the output\n151\t        // stays byte-identical to the pre-#219 three-argument render. When provided, inject the\n152\t        // per-node status badges + CSS, the node-statuses side-table, and — when includeRefresh — the\n153\t        // auto-reload meta tag (see InjectStatusOverlay).\n154\t        if (nodeStatuses is not null)\n155\t        {\n156\t            html = InjectStatusOverlay(html, nodeStatuses, includeRefresh);\n157\t        }\n158\t\n159\t        // Normalize the full output — the template raw-string literal (and the injected blocks above)\n160\t        // pick up \\r\\n when the file is checked out with CRLF on Windows; the mermaid source is\n161\t        // already normalized above.\n162\t        return html\n163\t            .Replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n164\t            .Replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n165\t    }\n166\t\n167\t    /// <summary>\n168\t    /// Inject the live-run status overlay (issue #219) into the base <paramref name=\"html\"/>: the\n169\t    /// per-node status-badge markup + CSS, the <c>#node-statuses</c> JSON side-table, and — when\n170\t    /// <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> — the <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"&gt;</c> auto-reload\n171\t    /// tag. Called ONLY on the non-null path (see <see cref=\"Render\"/>), so the static-graph output is\n172\t    /// left byte-identical.\n173\t    /// </summary>\n174\t    /// <remarks>\n175\t    /// Mirrors the existing title-band overlay's post-render-script technique: the badges are HTML\n176\t    /// overlay <c>&lt;div&gt;</c>s (like <c>#bar</c>/<c>#legend</c>) rendered OUTSIDE the SVG and\n177\t    /// anchored to each node's on-screen box via <c>getBoundingClientRect()</c>. Because they live in\n178\t    /// screen space rather than inside the SVG, they are re-anchored on every <c>svg-pan-zoom</c>\n179\t    /// pan/zoom (wired through the pan-zoom instance's <c>onPan</c>/<c>onZoom</c> callbacks) and on\n180\t    /// window resize. A <c>running</c> node shows an animated CSS-<c>@keyframes</c> spinner (no\n181\t    /// external image); every other (settled) status shows a static glyph. The auto-reload tag is\n182\t    /// INDEPENDENT of the overlay (mirrors <c>LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)</c>'s\n183\t    /// during-run vs final duality) — present for the during-run diagram, dropped for the final\n184\t    /// settled render.\n185\t    /// </remarks>\n186\t    private static string InjectStatusOverlay(\n187\t        string html, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeStatuses, bool includeRefresh)\n188\t    {\n189\t        // Same relaxed-encoder side-table treatment as taskFolderTargets: a JSON object (node id ->\n190\t        // status word) read back via textContent from a <script type=\"application/json\"> element.\n191\t        string statusesJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(nodeStatuses, new JsonSerializerOptions\n192\t        {\n193\t (includeRefresh)\n198\t        {\n199\t            html = html.Replace(\n200\t                \"<meta name=\\\"viewport\\\" content=\\\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\\\">\",\n201\t                \"<meta name=\\\"viewport\\\" content=\\\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\\\">\\n\"\n202\t                    + \"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\" content=\\\"2\\\">\",\n203\t \"</style>\", StatusOverlayStyle + \"\\n</style>\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n209\t\n210\t        // The node id -> status side-table, mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table, placed just\n211\t        // before the svg-pan-zoom script so it is already in the DOM when the module script reads it.\n212\t        html = html.Replace(\n213\t            \"<script src=\\\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/svg-pan-zoom\",\n214\t            \"<script type=\\\"application/json\\\" id=\\\"node-statuses\\\">\" + statusesJson + \"</script>\\n\"\n215\t                + \"<script src=\\\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/svg-pan-zoom\",\n216\t            StringComparison.Ordinal);\n217\t\n218\t        // The overlay functions, defined just before `let pz = null;` (module title-band\n224\t        // overlay (so it measures the SVG in its final, wrap-corrected shape).\n225\t        html = html.Replace(\n226\t            \"  addTaskContainerOverlays(el);\",\n227\t zoomScaleSensitivity: 0.3,\\n\"\n234\t                + \"                        onPan: positionStatusBadges, onZoom: positionStatusBadges });\",\n235\t Live-run status-overlay CSS (issue #219), injected before </style> only on the non-null path.\n248\t    // The spinner is a pure CSS @keyframes rotation (no external image), inherently distinct from a\n249\t    // settled status's static glyph. `.status-<word>` colours mirror the log viewer's status palette.\n250\t    private const string StatusOverlayStyle = \"\"\"\n251\t\n252\t  #status-overlays { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9; }\n253\t  .status-badge { position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; width: 18px; height: 18px;\n254\t                  border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;\n255\t                  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #0b0f14;\n256\t                  border: 1px solid #0b0f14; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }\n257\t  .status-passed { background: #3fb950; }\n258\t  .status-failed { background: #f85149; color: #ffffff; }\n259\t
