{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MDjYAWFe4CERS94WhKxhLx","type":"tool_result","content":"230\t    }\n231\t\n232\t    /// <summary>\n233\t    /// The task-id → plan-relative folder path map <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> needs to inject\n234\t    /// the title-band click overlay (see class remarks, issue #235): a task container's click target\n235\t    /// is no longer a Mermaid-source mechanism, so this is how the same path data\n236\t    /// <see cref=\"AppendClickDirectives\"/> used to feed the removed anchor's <c>click href</c> now\n237\t    /// reaches the post-render JavaScript instead — as a small embedded JSON side-table keyed by the\n238\t    /// SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/> emits, so the\n239\t    /// overlay script can look a cluster's target up by its own DOM id. Plan-relative, forward-slash\n240\t    /// paths (not OS separators, not absolute) for the same byte-identical-across-OSes reason as\n241\t    /// <see cref=\"ToPlanRelative\"/>.\n242\t    /// </summary>\n243\t    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets(PlanDefinition plan)\n244\t    {\n245\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n246\t\n247\t        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n248\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n249\t\n250\t        var targets = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n251\t        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n252\t        {\n253\t            string containerId = $\"task_{nodeIdBase[task.Id]}\";\n254\t            targets[containerId] = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, task.Directory) + \"/\";\n255\t        }\n256\t\n257\t        return targets;\n258\t    }\n259\t\n260\t    /// <summary>\n261\t    /// The cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines (colors) for the LEAF check nodes — preflight check\n262\t    /// and guardrail check — which reference them inline via <c>:::preflight</c>/<c>:::guardrail</c>.\n263\t    /// The task-container and plan-level-container fills are applied per-container by a\n264\t    /// <c>style &lt;id&gt; …</c> statement instead (see <see cref=\"TaskStyle\"/> /\n265\t    /// <see cref=\"PlanLevelStyle\"/>), because a <c>class</c> assignment does not reach a subgraph\n266\t    /// that is an edge endpoint in the bundled Mermaid. Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n267\t    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n268\t    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n269\t    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n270\t    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n271\t    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n272\t    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n273\t    /// </summary>\n274\t    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)\n275\t    {\n276\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff,stroke:#6f42c1,color:#2e1065;\");\n277\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b,color:#3d2c00;\");\n278\t    }\n279\t\n280\t    /// <summary>\n281\t    /// The SEMANTIC content of the diagram: ONLY the containers + nested checks + container edges\n282\t    /// (with their drawn labels), with NO <c>flowchart TD</c> header and NO cosmetic\n283\t    /// <c>classDef</c> color definitions. This is what <see cref=\"GraphSourceHash\"/> hashes, so\n284\t    /// the staleness key tracks exactly what the diagram DRAWS (container membership, nested\n285\t    /// check labels, DAG shape) — including the PLAN-LEVEL <c>preflights/</c>/<c>guardrails/</c>\n286\t    /// folder checks, not just <c>tasks{}</c>, so editing a Terminal Gate check moves the hash\n287\t    /// too. Shares the single <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> emitter with <see cref=\"Render\"/>,\n288\t    /// so the two can never drift.\n289\t    /// </summary>\n290\t    internal static string SemanticContent(PlanDefinition plan)\n291\t    {\n292\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n293\t\n294\t        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n295\t        AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n296\t        return sb.ToString();\n297\t    }\n298\t\n299\t    /// <summary>\n300\t    /// Append the container model (the semantic content) for the plan: the plan-level Full Flight\n301\t    /// Checks container, one container per task in ordinal order, the plan-level Terminal Gate\n302\t    /// container, and finally every container→container edge. The single shared emitter behind\n303\t    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>, <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>, and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> —\n304\t    /// all three now emit the IDENTICAL container/node shape (issue #235 removed the interactive-only\n305\t    /// anchor node), so <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> differ ONLY in\n306\t    /// whether <c>click</c> directives for CHECK nodes are appended afterward. Returns the\n307\t    /// task-id → node-id-base map so the caller can emit click directives against the SAME node ids\n308\t    /// (the emitted bytes are unchanged whether or not the caller uses the return value).\n309\t    /// </summary>\n310\t    /// <remarks>\n311\t    /// ORDER MATTERS: every container is emitted (fully, including its <c>end</c>) BEFORE any\n312\t    /// container→container edge line. A <c>subgraph A --&gt; subgraph B</c> edge references the two\n313\t    /// container ids, so both subgraph blocks must already be declared; emitting all containers\n314\t    /// first keeps every edge's endpoints resolvable and the output deterministic.\n315\t    /// </remarks>\n316\t    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AppendNodesAndEdges(PlanDefinition plan, StringBuilder sb)\n317\t    {\n318\t        var graph = new DependencyGraph(plan.Tasks);\n319\t\n320\t        // Ordinal task order throughout (repo convention).\n321\t        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks\n322\t            .OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n323\t            .ToList();\n324\t\n325\t        // Allocate an injective node-id base per task ONCE, in ordinal order: a task whose\n326\t        // sanitized id collides with an earlier one gets a deterministic _2, _3, … suffix.\n327\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n328\t\n329\t        // --- plan-level \"Full Flight Checks\" container (top, ALWAYS emitted) -----------\n330\t        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanPreflightsId, \"Full Flight Checks\", plan.PlanPreflights, \"preflight\");\n331\t\n332\t        // --- one container per task ------------------------------------------------------\n333\t        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n334\t        {\n335\t            AppendTaskContainer(sb, task, nodeIdBase[task.Id]);\n336\t        }\n337\t\n338\t        // --- plan-level \"Terminal Gate\" container (bottom, ALWAYS emitted) --------------\n339\t        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanGuardrailsId, \"Terminal Gate\", plan.PlanGuardrails, \"guardrail\");\n340\t\n341\t        // --- container→container edges (every container above is already fully declared) -----\n342\t        AppendContainerEdges(graph, tasks, nodeIdBase, sb);\n343\t\n344\t        return nodeIdBase;\n345\t    }\n346\t\n347\t    /// <summary>\n348\t    /// Append a plan-level bracket container (<c>plan_preflights</c> or <c>plan_guardrails</c>):\n349\t    /// its checks (sorted ordinal by name) as small boxes inside, styled with\n350\t    /// <paramref name=\"checkClass\"/>. ALWAYS emitted, even when <paramref name=\"checks\"/> is empty\n351\t    /// — the two plan-level containers are structural brackets on the whole DAG, not conditional\n352\t    /// content. The DAG edge attaches to this container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n353\t    /// </summary>\n354\t    private static void AppendPlanLevelContainer(\n355\t        StringBuilder sb,\n356\t        string containerId,\n357\t        string label,\n358\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n359\t        string checkClass)\n360\t    {\n361\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(label)}]\");\n362\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}\", checks, checkClass);\n363\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n364\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {PlanLevelStyle}\");\n365\t    }\n366\t\n367\t    /// <summary>\n368\t    /// Append one task container: its preflight leaf check node(s) (if any), THEN its guardrail\n369\t    /// leaf check node(s) — both DIRECTLY inside the container, with no nested\n370\t    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n371\t    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n372\t    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n373\t    /// </summary>\n374\t    /// <remarks>\n375\t    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n376\t    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n377\t    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n378\t    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n379\t    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n380\t    /// </remarks>\n381\t    /// <remarks>\n382\t    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n383\t    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n384\t    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n385\t    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n386\t    /// </remarks>\n387\t    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n388\t    {\n389\t        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n390\t\n391\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n392\t\n393\t        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n394\t        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n395\t        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n396\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n397\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n398\t\n399\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n400\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n401\t    }\n402\t\n403\t    /// <summary>\n404\t    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n405\t    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n406\t    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n407\t    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n408\t    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n409\t    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n410\t    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n411\t    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n412\t    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n413\t    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n414\t    /// needed anywhere now.\n415\t    /// </summary>\n416\t    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n417\t        StringBuilder sb,\n418\t        string indent,\n419\t        string nodeIdPrefix,\n420\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n421\t        string checkClass)\n422\t    {\n423\t        int ordinal = 0;\n424\t        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n425\t        {\n426\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n427\t            ordinal++;\n428\t        }\n429\t    }\n430\t\n431\t    /// <summary>\n432\t    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n433\t    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n434\t    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n435\t    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n436\t    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n437\t    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n438\t    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n439\t    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n440\t    /// </summary>\n441\t    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n442\t        DependencyGraph graph,\n443\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n444\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n445\t        StringBuilder sb)\n446\t    {\n447\t        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n448\t        {\n449\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n450\t        }\n451\t\n452\t        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n453\t        {\n454\t            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n455\t                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n456\t            {\n457\t                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n458\t            }\n459\t        }\n460\t\n461\t        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n462\t        {\n463\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n464\t        }\n465\t    }\n466\t\n467\t    /// <summary>\n468\t    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n469\t    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n470\t    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n471\t    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n472\t    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n473\t    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n474\t    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n475\t    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n476\t    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n477\t    /// </summary>\n478\t    /// <remarks>\n479\t    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click\n480\t    /// target is no longer a Mermaid mechanism at all — see class remarks, \"A task container's click\n481\t    /// target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\". <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects it via\n482\t    /// JavaScript after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/> for the\n483\t    /// folder path data. Leaf check-node clicks are unaffected here: they still target the leaf node\n484\t    /// itself, which Mermaid DOES wrap in a real clickable <c>&lt;a href&gt;</c>.\n485\t    /// </remarks>\n486\t    private static void AppendClickDirectives(\n487\t        PlanDefinition plan, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase, StringBuilder sb)\n488\t    {\n489\t        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanPreflights, PlanPreflightsId, sb);\n490\t\n491\t        foreach (TaskNode task in plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n492\t        {\n493\t            string @base = nodeIdBase[task.Id];\n494\t            string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n495\t\n496\t            if (task.Preflights.Count > 0)\n497\t            {\n498\t                AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Preflights, $\"{containerId}_pf\", sb);\n499\t            }\n500\t\n501\t            AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Guardrails, $\"{containerId}_gr\", sb);\n502\t        }\n503\t\n504\t        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanGuardrails, PlanGuardrailsId, sb);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    /// <summary>\n508\t    /// Append one <c>click</c> directive per check in <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by\n509\t    /// name, mirroring <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> exactly so the ordinal-suffixed node id each\n510\t    /// click targets is the one actually emitted for that check). The tooltip is ALWAYS\n511\t    /// <c>Description ?? Name</c> in full, for every check kind at both scopes — since the drawn\n512\t    /// label is now always the short <c>Name</c> (issue #222), the tooltip is the one place the\n513\t    /// full description lives; there is no longer a \"some checks get the full text, others don't\"\n514\t    /// distinction.\n515\t    /// </summary>\n516\t    private static void AppendCheckClicks(\n517\t        PlanDefinition plan,\n518\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n519\t        string nodeIdPrefix,\n520\t        StringBuilder sb)\n521\t    {\n522\t        int ordinal = 0;\n523\t        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n524\t        {\n525\t            string checkPath = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, check.Path);\n526\t            string tooltipText = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(check.Description) ? check.Name : check.Description!;\n527\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  click {nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal} href \\\"{checkPath}\\\" \\\"{ClickTooltip(tooltipText)}\\\" _blank\");\n528\t            ordinal++;\n529\t        }"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b082e741-5793-429b-be34-e97726bd8b3f","uuid":"402bab1e-d6d5-456a-a57f-89c9b6e8081e","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:41:43.159Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Core\\Graph\\MermaidRenderer.cs","content":"    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The task-id → plan-relative folder path map <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> needs to inject\n    /// the title-band click overlay (see class remarks, issue #235): a task container's click target\n    /// is no longer a Mermaid-source mechanism, so this is how the same path data\n    /// <see cref=\"AppendClickDirectives\"/> used to feed the removed anchor's <c>click href</c> now\n    /// reaches the post-render JavaScript instead — as a small embedded JSON side-table keyed by the\n    /// SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/> emits, so the\n    /// overlay script can look a cluster's target up by its own DOM id. Plan-relative, forward-slash\n    /// paths (not OS separators, not absolute) for the same byte-identical-across-OSes reason as\n    /// <see cref=\"ToPlanRelative\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n\n        var targets = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            string containerId = $\"task_{nodeIdBase[task.Id]}\";\n            targets[containerId] = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, task.Directory) + \"/\";\n        }\n\n        return targets;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines (colors) for the LEAF check nodes — preflight check\n    /// and guardrail check — which reference them inline via <c>:::preflight</c>/<c>:::guardrail</c>.\n    /// The task-container and plan-level-container fills are applied per-container by a\n    /// <c>style &lt;id&gt; …</c> statement instead (see <see cref=\"TaskStyle\"/> /\n    /// <see cref=\"PlanLevelStyle\"/>), because a <c>class</c> assignment does not reach a subgraph\n    /// that is an edge endpoint in the bundled Mermaid. Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff,stroke:#6f42c1,color:#2e1065;\");\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b,color:#3d2c00;\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The SEMANTIC content of the diagram: ONLY the containers + nested checks + container edges\n    /// (with their drawn labels), with NO <c>flowchart TD</c> header and NO cosmetic\n    /// <c>classDef</c> color definitions. This is what <see cref=\"GraphSourceHash\"/> hashes, so\n    /// the staleness key tracks exactly what the diagram DRAWS (container membership, nested\n    /// check labels, DAG shape) — including the PLAN-LEVEL <c>preflights/</c>/<c>guardrails/</c>\n    /// folder checks, not just <c>tasks{}</c>, so editing a Terminal Gate check moves the hash\n    /// too. Shares the single <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> emitter with <see cref=\"Render\"/>,\n    /// so the two can never drift.\n    /// </summary>\n    internal static string SemanticContent(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n        AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n        return sb.ToString();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append the container model (the semantic content) for the plan: the plan-level Full Flight\n    /// Checks container, one container per task in ordinal order, the plan-level Terminal Gate\n    /// container, and finally every container→container edge. The single shared emitter behind\n    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>, <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>, and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> —\n    /// all three now emit the IDENTICAL container/node shape (issue #235 removed the interactive-only\n    /// anchor node), so <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> differ ONLY in\n    /// whether <c>click</c> directives for CHECK nodes are appended afterward. Returns the\n    /// task-id → node-id-base map so the caller can emit click directives against the SAME node ids\n    /// (the emitted bytes are unchanged whether or not the caller uses the return value).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// ORDER MATTERS: every container is emitted (fully, including its <c>end</c>) BEFORE any\n    /// container→container edge line. A <c>subgraph A --&gt; subgraph B</c> edge references the two\n    /// container ids, so both subgraph blocks must already be declared; emitting all containers\n    /// first keeps every edge's endpoints resolvable and the output deterministic.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AppendNodesAndEdges(PlanDefinition plan, StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        var graph = new DependencyGraph(plan.Tasks);\n\n        // Ordinal task order throughout (repo convention).\n        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks\n            .OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n            .ToList();\n\n        // Allocate an injective node-id base per task ONCE, in ordinal order: a task whose\n        // sanitized id collides with an earlier one gets a deterministic _2, _3, … suffix.\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n\n        // --- plan-level \"Full Flight Checks\" container (top, ALWAYS emitted) -----------\n        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanPreflightsId, \"Full Flight Checks\", plan.PlanPreflights, \"preflight\");\n\n        // --- one container per task ------------------------------------------------------\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            AppendTaskContainer(sb, task, nodeIdBase[task.Id]);\n        }\n\n        // --- plan-level \"Terminal Gate\" container (bottom, ALWAYS emitted) --------------\n        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanGuardrailsId, \"Terminal Gate\", plan.PlanGuardrails, \"guardrail\");\n\n        // --- container→container edges (every container above is already fully declared) -----\n        AppendContainerEdges(graph, tasks, nodeIdBase, sb);\n\n        return nodeIdBase;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append a plan-level bracket container (<c>plan_preflights</c> or <c>plan_guardrails</c>):\n    /// its checks (sorted ordinal by name) as small boxes inside, styled with\n    /// <paramref name=\"checkClass\"/>. ALWAYS emitted, even when <paramref name=\"checks\"/> is empty\n    /// — the two plan-level containers are structural brackets on the whole DAG, not conditional\n    /// content. The DAG edge attaches to this container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendPlanLevelContainer(\n        StringBuilder sb,\n        string containerId,\n        string label,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string checkClass)\n    {\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(label)}]\");\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}\", checks, checkClass);\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {PlanLevelStyle}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append one task container: its preflight leaf check node(s) (if any), THEN its guardrail\n    /// leaf check node(s) — both DIRECTLY inside the container, with no nested\n    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n    /// </remarks>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n    {\n        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n\n        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n    /// needed anywhere now.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n        StringBuilder sb,\n        string indent,\n        string nodeIdPrefix,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string checkClass)\n    {\n        int ordinal = 0;\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n            ordinal++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n        DependencyGraph graph,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n        StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n        {\n            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n            {\n                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click\n    /// target is no longer a Mermaid mechanism at all — see class remarks, \"A task container's click\n    /// target is a POST-RENDER SVG overlay...\". <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects it via\n    /// JavaScript after Mermaid's render completes, using <see cref=\"TaskFolderTargets\"/> for the\n    /// folder path data. Leaf check-node clicks are unaffected here: they still target the leaf node\n    /// itself, which Mermaid DOES wrap in a real clickable <c>&lt;a href&gt;</c>.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static void AppendClickDirectives(\n        PlanDefinition plan, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase, StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanPreflights, PlanPreflightsId, sb);\n\n        foreach (TaskNode task in plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            string @base = nodeIdBase[task.Id];\n            string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n\n            if (task.Preflights.Count > 0)\n            {\n                AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Preflights, $\"{containerId}_pf\", sb);\n            }\n\n            AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Guardrails, $\"{containerId}_gr\", sb);\n        }\n\n        AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanGuardrails, PlanGuardrailsId, sb);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append one <c>click</c> directive per check in <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by\n    /// name, mirroring <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> exactly so the ordinal-suffixed node id each\n    /// click targets is the one actually emitted for that check). The tooltip is ALWAYS\n    /// <c>Description ?? Name</c> in full, for every check kind at both scopes — since the drawn\n    /// label is now always the short <c>Name</c> (issue #222), the tooltip is the one place the\n    /// full description lives; there is no longer a \"some checks get the full text, others don't\"\n    /// distinction.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendCheckClicks(\n        PlanDefinition plan,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string nodeIdPrefix,\n        StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        int ordinal = 0;\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            string checkPath = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, check.Path);\n            string tooltipText = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(check.Description) ? check.Name : check.Description!;\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  click {nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal} href \\\"{checkPath}\\\" \\\"{ClickTooltip(tooltipText)}\\\" _blank\");\n            ordinal++;\n        }","numLines":300,"startLine":230,"totalLines":648}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013LUKUA8YksS1o5ekTNdn53","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n2\tusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\n3\tusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\n4\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n5\t\n6\tnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n7\t\n8\t/// <summary>\n9\t/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n10\t/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n11\t/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n12\t/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n13\t/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n14\t/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n15\t/// </summary>\n16\tpublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n17\t{\n18\t    [Fact]\n19\t    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n20\t    {\n21\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n22\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n23\t        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n24\t        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n25\t\n26\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n27\t            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n28\t            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n29\t\n30\t        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n31\t        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n32\t        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n33\t        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n34\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n35\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n36\t\n37\t        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n38\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n39\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n40\t        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n41\t        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n42\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n43\t\n44\t        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n45\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n46\t        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n47\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n48\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n50\t        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n51\t            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n52\t\n53\t        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n54\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    [Fact]\n58\t    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n59\t    {\n60\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n61\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n62\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n63\t\n64\t        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n65\t        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n66\t        var journal = new JournalDocument\n67\t        {\n68\t            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n69\t            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n70\t            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n71\t            {\n72\t                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n73\t            },\n74\t        };\n75\t\n76\t        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n77\t\n78\t        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n79\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n80\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n81\t    }\n82\t\n83\t    [Fact]\n84\t    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n85\t    {\n86\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n87\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n88\t        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n89\t\n90\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n91\t\n92\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n93\t        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n94\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n95\t\n96\t        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n97\t            inner.Events);\n98\t    }\n99\t\n100\t    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n101\t        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n102\t\n103\t    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n104\t    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n105\t    {\n106\t        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n107\t\n108\t        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n109\t        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n110\t        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n111\t    }\n112\t\n113\t    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n114\t    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n115\t    {\n116\t        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n117\t\n118\t        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n119\t\n120\t        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n121\t\n122\t        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n123\t\n124\t        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n125\t        {\n126\t            Id = id,\n127\t            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n128\t            Description = \"task \" + id,\n129\t            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n130\t            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n131\t        };\n132\t\n133\t        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n134\t        {\n135\t            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n136\t            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n137\t            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n138\t        }\n139\t\n140\t        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n141\t\n142\t        public void Dispose()\n143\t        {\n144\t            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n145\t        }\n146\t    }\n147\t}\n148\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b082e741-5793-429b-be34-e97726bd8b3f","uuid":"07b469b4-904c-4f88-8f5b-e2c7f4831a3f","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:42:38.678Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n\n        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n\n        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n\n        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n\n        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n\n        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n        var journal = new JournalDocument\n        {\n            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n            {\n                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n            },\n        };\n\n        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n\n        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n\n        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n\n    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n        {\n            Id = id,\n            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n            Description = \"task \" + id,\n            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n        };\n\n        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n        {\n            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n        }\n\n        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":148,"startLine":1,"totalLines":148}}}

The aggregated <see cref=\"GuardrailRunResult\"/> tells the attempt loop\n/// whether any failed and whether a timeout was involved.\n/// </summary>\ninternal sealed class GuardrailRunner\n{\n    private readonly PlanDefinition _plan;\n    private readonly IRunObserver _observer;\n    private readonly ScriptUnitRunner _scriptRunner;\n    private readonly PromptExecutionSupport _promptSupport;\n    private readonly Func<TaskNode, int?, TimeSpan> _resolveTimeout;\n\n    public GuardrailRunner(\n        PlanDefinition plan,\n        IRunObserver observer,\n        ScriptUnitRunner scriptRunner,\n        PromptExecutionSupport promptSupport,\n        Func<TaskNode, int?, TimeSpan> resolveTimeout)\n    {\n        _plan = plan;\n        _observer = observer;\n        _scriptRunner = scriptRunner;\n        _promptSupport = promptSupport;\n        _resolveTimeout = resolveTimeout;\n    }\n\n    public async Task<GuardrailRunResult> RunAsync(\n        TaskNode task,\n        string workspace,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> env,\n        string snapshotPath,\n        string logDir,\n        CancellationToken cancellationToken,\n        string? await RunPromptGuardrailAsync(task, guardrail, workspace, env, snapshotPath, logDir, cancellationToken, worktreeRoot).ConfigureAwait(false)\n                : await RunScriptGuardrailAsync(task, guardrail, workspace, env, logDir, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);\n\n            results.Add(result);\n            _observer.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)\n            {\n                break; // the caller turns this into a cancelled attempt\n            }\n\n            if (!result.Passed)\n            {\n                anyFailed = true;\n                timedOut |= guardrailTimedOut;\n                if (_plan.Config.GuardrailMode == GuardrailMode.FailFast)\n                {\n                    break;\n                }","numLines":70,"startLine":1,"totalLines":235}}}

This drives the real CLI end-to-end (mirroring <c>PlanGuardrailPhaseTests</c>' <c>CommandFactory\n13\t/// .BuildRootCommand</c> + <see cref=\"StringConsoleIo\"/> pattern) against a small script-only plan, then reads\n14\t/// the generated <c>diagram.html</c> off disk.\n15\t/// <para>\n16\t/// A real plan already carries <c>diagram.html</c> BEFORE it is ever run — <c>/plan-breakdown</c> writes it\n17\t/// once via <c>guardrails graph</c> (<c>Guardrails.Core.Breakdown.BreakdownManifest</c>). This fixture\n18\t/// reproduces exactly that starting state: an explicit <c>graph</c> invocation writes the plain static render\n19\t/// (no per-node status at all) BEFORE <c>run</c> ever executes.\n20\t/// </para>\n21\t/// <para>\n22\t/// RED on current code: <c>run</c> never touches <c>diagram.html</c>, so after a wholly-green run it is left\n23\t/// byte-for-byte the static render <c>graph</c> wrote above — no <c>#node-statuses</c> side-table at all, so\n24\t/// the settled-status assertion below fails. That failure is exactly the TDD red\n25\t/// <c>06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand</c> turns green, by constructing <c>OnTheFlyDiagramObserver</c>\n26\t/// during the run AND adding a final, non-refreshing export at run end (mirroring <c>RunCommand</c>'s existing\n27\t/// <c>LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite</c> call for the analogous log site). This test deliberately does NOT\n28\t/// construct <c>OnTheFlyDiagramObserver</c> itself, and does NOT hand-wire the scheduler with it pre-injected\n29\t/// — either would make the test pass even though production code never wires it, which is exactly the\n30\t/// false-green issue #120 warns against.\n31\t/// </para>\n32\t/// </summary>\n33\tpublic sealed class DiagramLiveStatusWiringTests\n34\t{\n35\t    private static async Task<int> RunCliAsync(params string[] args)\n36\t    {\n37\t        var io = new StringConsoleIo();\n38\t        RootCommand root = CommandFactory.BuildRootCommand(io);\n39\t        return await root.Parse(args).InvokeAsync();\n40\t    }\n41\t\n42\t    [Fact]\n43\t    public async Task SettledRun_LeavesDiagramHtml_WithoutLiveStatus_ComposingRootGap()\n44\t    {\n45\t        using var plan = new ScriptPlanBuilder()\n46\t            .AddTask(\"01-first\")\n47\t            .AddTask(\"02-second\", true, true, \"01-first\");\n48\t\n49\t        // Reproduce the real starting state: a plan's diagram.html already exists (written once by\n50\t        // /plan-breakdown via `guardrails graph`) before the plan is ever run.\n51\t        int graphExit = await RunCliAsync(\"graph\", plan.PlanDir);\n52\t        Assert.Equal(ExitCodes.Success, graphExit);\n53\t\n54\t        string htmlPath = Path.Combine(plan.PlanDir, \"diagram.html\");\n55\t        Assert.True(File.Exists(htmlPath), \"guardrails graph must write diagram.html before the run\");\n56\t\n57\t        int runExit = await RunCliAsync(\"run\", plan.PlanDir, \"--no-ui\", \"--no-log-server\");\n58\t        Assert.Equal(ExitCodes.Success, runExit);\n59\t\n60\t        string html = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(htmlPath, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);\n61\t\n62\t        // The settled outcome must be reflected: the task known to have succeeded shows \"passed\" in the\n63\t        // embedded #node-statuses side-table (HtmlDiagramRenderer's optional nodeStatuses parameter). RED\n64\t        // today — nothing wires OnTheFlyDiagramObserver into RunCommand, so this side-table is never\n65\t        // present at all; diagram.html is exactly the plain graph render written above.\n66\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeStatuses = ReadNodeStatuses(html);\n67\t        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", nodeStatuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_first\"));\n68\t\n69\t        // Independent of the above: the FINAL, post-run diagram.html must be fully static — no\n70\t        // auto-refresh meta tag (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run-vs-final duality; a run-end export\n71\t        // that forgot the final, non-refreshing render would leave this refreshing forever).\n72\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n73\t    }\n74\t\n75\t    /// <summary>\n76\t    /// Extract the <c>#node-statuses</c> JSON side-table <c>HtmlDiagramRenderer</c> embeds only when a live\n77\t    /// status map is supplied. Absent entirely on the plain <c>graph</c> render, which is exactly the RED\n78\t    /// signal this test relies on.\n79\t    /// </summary>\n80\t    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> ReadNodeStatuses(string html)\n81\t    {\n82\t        const string marker = \"<script type=\\\"application/json\\\" id=\\\"node-statuses\\\">\";\n83\t        int start = html.IndexOf(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n84\t        Assert.True(start >= 0,\n85\t            \"diagram.html has no #node-statuses side-table — nothing wires a live status observer into \" +\n86\t            \"RunCommand yet (issue #120 composition-root gap).\");\n87\t\n88\t        start += marker.Length;\n89\t        int end = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", start, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n90\t        Assert.True(end >= 0, \"malformed #node-statuses script tag in diagram.html\");\n91\t\n92\t        string json = html[start..end];\n93\t        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(json) ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();\n94\t    }\n95\t}\n96\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b082e741-5793-429b-be34-e97726bd8b3f","uuid":"24c3239a-896b-48e2-9ceb-3060e54f6d01","timestamp":"2026-07-07T16:44:42.814Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\1bb6c1ff\\03-author-tests-diagram-observer\\attempt-1\\tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\DiagramLiveStatusWiringTests.cs","content":"using System.CommandLine;\nusing System.Text.Json;\nusing Guardrails.Cli;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// The composition-root wiring test for the live diagram (issue #120 doctrine). <c>OnTheFlyDiagramObserver</c>\n/// (04-implement-diagram-observer) is implemented and independently unit-tested, but nothing in\n/// <c>Guardrails.Cli.Commands.RunCommand</c> constructs or injects it yet — so a REAL <c>guardrails run</c>\n/// never actually calls it, and a plan's <c>diagram.html</c> never reflects the run's progress or its settled\n/// outcome. This drives the real CLI end-to-end (mirroring <c>PlanGuardrailPhaseTests</c>' <c>CommandFactory\n/// .BuildRootCommand</c> + <see cref=\"StringConsoleIo\"/> pattern) against a small script-only plan, then reads\n/// the generated <c>diagram.html</c> off disk.\n/// <para>\n/// A real plan already carries <c>diagram.html</c> BEFORE it is ever run — <c>/plan-breakdown</c> writes it\n/// once via <c>guardrails graph</c> (<c>Guardrails.Core.Breakdown.BreakdownManifest</c>). This fixture\n/// reproduces exactly that starting state: an explicit <c>graph</c> invocation writes the plain static render\n/// (no per-node status at all) BEFORE <c>run</c> ever executes.\n/// </para>\n/// <para>\n/// RED on current code: <c>run</c> never touches <c>diagram.html</c>, so after a wholly-green run it is left\n/// byte-for-byte the static render <c>graph</c> wrote above — no <c>#node-statuses</c> side-table at all, so\n/// the settled-status assertion below fails. That failure is exactly the TDD red\n/// <c>06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand</c> turns green, by constructing <c>OnTheFlyDiagramObserver</c>\n/// during the run AND adding a final, non-refreshing export at run end (mirroring <c>RunCommand</c>'s existing\n/// <c>LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite</c> call for the analogous log site). This test deliberately does NOT\n/// construct <c>OnTheFlyDiagramObserver</c> itself, and does NOT hand-wire the scheduler with it pre-injected\n/// — either would make the test pass even though production code never wires it, which is exactly the\n/// false-green issue #120 warns against.\n/// </para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class DiagramLiveStatusWiringTests\n{\n    private static async Task<int> RunCliAsync(params string[] args)\n    {\n        var io = new StringConsoleIo();\n        RootCommand root = CommandFactory.BuildRootCommand(io);\n        return await root.Parse(args).InvokeAsync();\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task SettledRun_LeavesDiagramHtml_WithoutLiveStatus_ComposingRootGap()\n    {\n        using var plan = new ScriptPlanBuilder()\n            .AddTask(\"01-first\")\n            .AddTask(\"02-second\", true, true, \"01-first\");\n\n        // Reproduce the real starting state: a plan's diagram.html already exists (written once by\n        // /plan-breakdown via `guardrails graph`) before the plan is ever run.\n        int graphExit = await RunCliAsync(\"graph\", plan.PlanDir);\n        Assert.Equal(ExitCodes.Success, graphExit);\n\n        string htmlPath = Path.Combine(plan.PlanDir, \"diagram.html\");\n        Assert.True(File.Exists(htmlPath), \"guardrails graph must write diagram.html before the run\");\n\n        int runExit = await RunCliAsync(\"run\", plan.PlanDir, \"--no-ui\", \"--no-log-server\");\n        Assert.Equal(ExitCodes.Success, runExit);\n\n        string html = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(htmlPath, TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);\n\n        // The settled outcome must be reflected: the task known to have succeeded shows \"passed\" in the\n        // embedded #node-statuses side-table (HtmlDiagramRenderer's optional nodeStatuses parameter). RED\n        // today — nothing wires OnTheFlyDiagramObserver into RunCommand, so this side-table is never\n        // present at all; diagram.html is exactly the plain graph render written above.\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeStatuses = ReadNodeStatuses(html);\n        Assert.Equal(\"passed\", nodeStatuses.GetValueOrDefault(\"task_01_first\"));\n\n        // Independent of the above: the FINAL, post-run diagram.html must be fully static — no\n        // auto-refresh meta tag (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run-vs-final duality; a run-end export\n        // that forgot the final, non-refreshing render would leave this refreshing forever).\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Extract the <c>#node-statuses</c> JSON side-table <c>HtmlDiagramRenderer</c> embeds only when a live\n    /// status map is supplied. Absent entirely on the plain <c>graph</c> render, which is exactly the RED\n    /// signal this test relies on.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> ReadNodeStatuses(string html)\n    {\n        const string marker = \"<script type=\\\"application/json\\\" id=\\\"node-statuses\\\">\";\n        int start = html.IndexOf(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(start >= 0,\n            \"diagram.html has no #node-statuses side-table — nothing wires a live status observer into \" +\n            \"RunCommand yet (issue #120 composition-root gap).\");\n\n        start += marker.Length;\n        int end = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", start, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(end >= 0, \"malformed #node-statuses script tag in diagram.html\");\n\n        string json = html[start..end];\n        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(json) ?? new Dictionary<string, string>();\n    }\n}\n","numLines":96,"startLine":1,"totalLines":96}}}
