\"\"\"\n        flowchart TD\n          subgraph task_root[\"root-task\"]\n            task_root_pf_0[\"pf-check-one\"]:::preflight\n            task_root_gr_0[\"gr-check-one\"]:::guardrail\n          end\n          style task_root fill:#cfe8ff;\n          classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff;\n          classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd;\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"search-input\\\"\", withoutStatuses, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"search-input\\\"\", withStatuses, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_SearchScript_ReferencesEveryNodeIdAndLabel()\n    {\n        // The search-matching data source must actually be POPULATED with the ids and visible\n        // labels a real Mermaid source produces — sliced to the dedicated #search-index side-table\n        // (not a bare page-wide Contains) so this cannot false-positive against the verbatim graph\n        // source, which already contains these same substrings regardless of the search feature.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(SearchSource, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        int indexStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"search-index\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(indexStart >= 0, \"the #search-index side-table must be present\");\n        int indexEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", indexStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string indexContent = html[indexStart..indexEnd];\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"root-task\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root_pf_0\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"pf-check-one\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root_gr_0\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"gr-check-one\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_SearchScript_DefinesAHighlightAndDimClass()\n    {\n        string html = Contains) so this cannot\n        // false-positive against a comment merely mentioning pz.pan/pz.zoom above the function —\n        // the stub throws before calling either, so this must fail until {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014kTrWYAU7wutaehCjpt7mo","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n2\tusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\n3\tusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\n4\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n5\t\n6\tnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n7\t\n8\t/// <summary>\n9\t/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n10\t/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n11\t/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n12\t/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n13\t/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n14\t/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n15\t/// </summary>\n16\tpublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n17\t{\n18\t    [Fact]\n19\t    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n20\t    {\n21\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n22\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n23\t        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n24\t        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n25\t\n26\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n27\t            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n28\t            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n29\t\n30\t        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n31\t        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n32\t        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n33\t        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n34\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n35\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n36\t\n37\t        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n38\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n39\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n40\t        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n41\t        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n42\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n43\t\n44\t        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n45\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n46\t        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n47\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n48\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n50\t        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n51\t            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n52\t\n53\t        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n54\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    [Fact]\n58\t    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n59\t    {\n60\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n61\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n62\t        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n63\t\n64\t        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n65\t        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n66\t        var journal = new JournalDocument\n67\t        {\n68\t            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n69\t            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n70\t            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n71\t            {\n72\t                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n73\t            },\n74\t        };\n75\t\n76\t        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n77\t\n78\t        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n79\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n80\t        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n81\t    }\n82\t\n83\t    [Fact]\n84\t    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n85\t    {\n86\t        using var temp = new TempSite();\n87\t        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n88\t        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n89\t\n90\t        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n91\t\n92\t        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n93\t        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n94\t        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n95\t\n96\t        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n97\t            inner.Events);\n98\t    }\n99\t\n100\t    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n101\t        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n102\t\n103\t    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n104\t    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n105\t    {\n106\t        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n107\t\n108\t        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n109\t        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n110\t        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n111\t    }\n112\t\n113\t    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n114\t    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n115\t    {\n116\t        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n117\t\n118\t        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n119\t\n120\t        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n121\t\n122\t        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n123\t\n124\t        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n125\t        {\n126\t            Id = id,\n127\t            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n128\t            Description = \"task \" + id,\n129\t            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n130\t            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n131\t        };\n132\t\n133\t        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n134\t        {\n135\t            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n136\t            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n137\t            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n138\t        }\n139\t\n140\t        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n141\t\n142\t        public void Dispose()\n143\t        {\n144\t            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n145\t        }\n146\t    }\n147\t}\n148\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da2e2042-c4b6-4ef5-b6ac-18dee996d70e","uuid":"a5ee2c33-56c9-4246-b86b-e83b24e875e7","timestamp":"2026-07-07T17:13:58.577Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"tests\\Guardrails.Integration.Tests\\OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.cs","content":"using Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Integration.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Exercises the on-the-fly static-site decorator (<see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>, issue #141\n/// item 2): as tasks settle it rewrites <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/index.html</c> with the right per-task link\n/// kind (running → live URL, settled-with-attempts → static page, pending → plain text) and a\n/// meta-refresh, writes each finished task's static page, and forwards EVERY event to the inner\n/// observer. Driven directly against the decorator with hand-written attempt logs (no agent), so the\n/// projection logic is asserted deterministically over the rendered HTML — JS is never executed.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteTests\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public void DuringRun_Index_ReflectsPendingRunningDone_WithLinkKinds_AndRefresh()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        TaskNode b = temp.Task(\"02-beta\");\n        var liveUrls = new Dictionary<string, string> { [\"01-alpha\"] = \"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\" };\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a, b],\n            liveUrlForTask: id => liveUrls.TryGetValue(id, out string? u) ? u : null);\n\n        // Initial: both pending → both plain text, with a meta-refresh.\n        observer.WriteInitialIndex();\n        string index0 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index0);   // during-run page refreshes itself\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"tasks/01-alpha\", index0);     // pending → no live link yet\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index0); // pending → no static link yet\n\n        // 01-alpha starts: it has an attempt dir AND a live URL → it links to the LIVE server.\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"running output\");\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        string index1 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index1); // running → live URL\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"running\\\"\", index1);\n\n        // 01-alpha finishes succeeded → it now links to its STATIC page; its page exists on disk.\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n        string index2 = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index2);      // settled → static page link\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http://127.0.0.1:5000/tasks/01-alpha\", index2); // no longer live\n        Assert.Contains(\"data-status=\\\"succeeded\\\"\", index2);\n        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(temp.LogsRoot, \"01-alpha\", \"index.html\")),\n            \"the finished task's static page must be written on finish (#141 items 1 & 2)\");\n\n        // 02-beta never started → still pending plain text (no link of either kind).\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"02-beta/index.html\", index2);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void DurableFinalSite_HasNoRefresh_AndAllStaticLinks()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        temp.WriteAttempt(\"01-alpha\", 1, \"action-stdout.log\", \"done\");\n\n        // The durable final/--export index is produced by ExportSite (the run-end path calls it): no\n        // meta-refresh, all-static links.\n        var journal = new JournalDocument\n        {\n            RunId = TempSite.RunId,\n            PlanHash = \"sha256:deadbeef\",\n            Tasks = new Dictionary<string, TaskJournalEntry>\n            {\n                [\"01-alpha\"] = new() { Status = Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded },\n            },\n        };\n\n        LogSiteRenderer.ExportSite(temp.LogsRoot, [a], journal);\n\n        string index = temp.ReadIndex();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", index); // durable artifact does not flicker\n        Assert.Contains(\"01-alpha/index.html\", index);          // settled task is a static link\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Decorator_ForwardsEveryEvent_ToTheInnerObserver()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode a = temp.Task(\"01-alpha\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver(inner, temp.LogsRoot, TempSite.RunId, [a], liveUrlForTask: null);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(a);\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(a, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-x\", Passed = true });\n        observer.TaskFinished(Result(\"01-alpha\", TaskOutcome.Succeeded));\n\n        Assert.Equal(new[] { \"TaskStarting:01-alpha\", \"GuardrailFinished:01-alpha\", \"TaskFinished:01-alpha\" },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    private static TaskResult Result(string id, TaskOutcome outcome) =>\n        new() { TaskId = id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = $\"{id} {outcome}\" };\n\n    /// <summary>Records the order/identity of every forwarded event so the decorator's pass-through is provable.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) => Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway logs/&lt;runId&gt;/ tree with helpers to write attempts and read the index.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public const string RunId = \"test-run\";\n\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string LogsRoot => Path.Combine(Dir, \"logs\", RunId);\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(LogsRoot);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id) => new()\n        {\n            Id = id,\n            Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n            Description = \"task \" + id,\n            Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n            Guardrails = [new GuardrailDefinition { Name = \"01-x\", Path = \"01-x.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script }],\n        };\n\n        public void WriteAttempt(string taskId, int attempt, string fileName, string content)\n        {\n            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(LogsRoot, taskId, $\"attempt-{attempt}\");\n            Directory.CreateDirectory(attemptDir);\n            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(attemptDir, fileName), content);\n        }\n\n        public string ReadIndex() => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(LogsRoot, \"index.html\"));\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); It\n/// WRAPS the real observer, forwards every event verbatim, and after certain events re-renders the\n/// diagram from an in-memory per-node status map via <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>'s\n/// optional <c>nodeStatuses</c> parameter (02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer):\n/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/> the task's CONTAINER node flips to <c>\"running\"</c>\n///     (coarse — per-check granularity for a task's own checks is unnecessary here since they have\n///     not run yet; it is driven by <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> instead).</item>\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> only the SPECIFIC preflight/guardrail leaf node that\n///     just finished flips to <c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c> — never the whole task container.</item>\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> the task's container flips to its settled status\n///     (<c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c>/<c>\"needs-human\"</c>, mapped from <see cref=\"TaskOutcome\"/>).</item>\n/// </list>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Design choice (this task's either/or):</b> the Mermaid source, its source hash, and the\n/// task-folder-targets map are threaded straight through the constructor — the same values the\n/// caller (mirroring <c>GraphCommand</c>'s <c>MermaidRenderer.RenderInteractive</c> /\n/// <c>TaskFolderTargets</c> calls) already computes from the live <c>PlanDefinition</c> — rather\n/// than re-parsing them back out of the already-written <c>diagram.html</c>'s embedded\n/// <c>&lt;script&gt;</c> tags. Threading is simpler and avoids a fragile round-trip through HTML/JSON\n/// that would break the moment the embedded markup's shape changes for an unrelated reason.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Node-id scheme.</b> <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/>'s injective task-id → node-id-base\n/// allocation (collision-safe sanitize + <c>_2</c>/<c>_3</c>… disambiguation) is <c>private</c>, so\n/// this class reproduces it character-for-character (see <see cref=\"AllocateNodeIdBases\"/> /\n/// <see cref=\"Sanitize\"/>) to compute the SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) and leaf ids\n/// (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;_pf_&lt;n&gt;</c> / <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;n&gt;</c>, <c>n</c> = the\n/// check's ordinal position when its task's <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>/\n/// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> are sorted ordinal by <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/>,\n/// exactly as <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c> emits them) that <c>diagram.html</c> already\n/// embeds, so a status badge lands on the right SVG node.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// This decorator's own status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads may call\n/// in concurrently, so all access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under\n/// one lock, mirroring <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>. Renders are best-effort: a render\n/// failure (e.g. a transient file lock, or a bad output path) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>MINIMAL STUB (this task authors failing tests only).</b> <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> always\n/// throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> — the real re-render (calling\n/// <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> and writing it to <c>diagram.html</c>) is\n/// <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c>'s job. Every status-map/node-id bookkeeping method above is\n/// real (not stubbed) so the authored tests encode the CORRECT expected node ids/statuses and turn\n/// green the moment <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> is implemented for real.\n/// </para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly string _diagramHtmlPath;\n    private readonly string _mermaidSource;\n    private readonly string _sourceHash;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _taskFolderTargets;\n\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _nodeIdBaseByTaskId;\n\n    // Per-node status word (container + leaf check ids). throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(tasks);\n        _diagramHtmlPath = diagramHtmlPath ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(diagramHtmlPath));\n        _mermaidSource = mermaidSource ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mermaidSource));\n        _sourceHash = sourceHash ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceHash));\n        _taskFolderTargets = taskFolderTargets ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(taskFolderTargets));\n\n        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        _nodeIdBaseByTaskId = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(ContainerId(task), \"running\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n        string? nodeId = ResolveCheckNodeId(task, result.Name);\n        if (nodeId is not null)\n        {\n            SetStatus(nodeId, result.Passed ? \"passed\" : \"failed\");\n        }\n\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? Holds the lock for the whole render\n    /// so the status snapshot is internally consistent. Best-effort via <see cref=\"TryRender\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void Render()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            var snapshot = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByNode, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => WriteDiagram(snapshot));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// MINIMAL STUB (issue #219 wiring): the real re-render — call\n    /// <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> with <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> and atomically\n    /// write the result to <see cref=\"_diagramHtmlPath\"/> — is <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c>'s\n    /// job. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the\n    /// next event. Mirrors <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s identical helper exactly.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a diagram-path permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- node-id resolution -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private string ContainerId(TaskNode task) => $\"task_{_nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id]}\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Resolve a finished check's specific leaf node id: <paramref name=\"checkName\"/> is looked up\n    /// first against <paramref name=\"task\"/>'s <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>, then its\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> (both sorted ordinal by name, mirroring\n    /// <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c>'s emission order) — so a task-level preflight and a\n    /// guardrail are never confused even if their names happened to collide. Returns null\n    /// (defensive — never set a status for an unrecognized check) when no check matches.\n    /// </summary>\n    private string? ResolveCheckNodeId(TaskNode task, string checkName)\n    {\n        string @base = _nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id];\n\n        int pfIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Preflights, checkName);\n        if (pfIndex >= 0)\n        {\n            return $\"task_{@base}_pf_{pfIndex}\";\n        }\n\n        int grIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Guardrails, checkName);\n        return grIndex >= 0 ? $\"task_{@base}_gr_{grIndex}\" : null;\n    }\n\n    private static int IndexOfByName(IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks, string name)\n    {\n        List<GuardrailDefinition> sorted = checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.Count; i++)\n        {\n            if (string.Equals(sorted[i].Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            {\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Map a finished task's outcome to one of the diagram's three settled status words — the\n    /// live/pending words (\"running\"/\"pending\") never apply here since the task has already\n    /// finished. <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Succeeded\"/>/<see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Skipped\"/> (resume found\n    /// it already succeeded) both read as \"passed\"; <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman\"/>/\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.RateLimited\"/>/<see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Cancelled\"/> (an ambiguous,\n    /// operator-actionable halt) all read as \"needs-human\"; everything else — a genuine action or\n    /// guardrail failure, an invalid fragment, or a blocked dependency — reads as \"failed\".\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.TransientPause\"/> never reaches here (never reported to\n    /// <see \"passed\",\n        TaskOutcome.Skipped => \"passed\",\n        TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman => \"needs-human\",\n        TaskOutcome.RateLimited => \"needs-human\",\n        TaskOutcome.Cancelled => \"needs-human\",\n        _ => \"failed\", // ActionFailed, GuardrailFailed, InvalidFragment, Blocked\n    };\n\n    // --- replicated from MermaidRenderer (private there) — see class remarks, \"Node-id scheme\" ---\n\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AllocateNodeIdBases(IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks)\n    {\n        List<TaskNode> ordered = tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, (TaskNode task in ordered)\n        {\n            string candidate = Sanitize(task.Id);\n            if (!taken.Add(candidate))\n            {\n                int suffix = 2;\n                string disambiguated;\n                do\n                {\n                    disambiguated = $\"{candidate}_{suffix}\";\n                    suffix++;\n                }\n                while (!taken.Add(disambiguated));\n\n                candidate = disambiguated;\n            }\n\n            bases[task.Id] = candidate;\n        }\n\n        return bases;\n    }\n\n    private static string Sanitize(string id)\n    {\n        var sb = new StringBuilder(id.Length);\n        foreach (char c in id)\n        {\n            bool safe = c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or (>= '0' and <= '9');\n            sb.Append(safe ? c : '_');\n        }\n\n        return sb.ToString();\n Mirrors <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s identical helper exactly.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a diagram-path permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- node-id resolution -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private string ContainerId(TaskNode task) => $\"task_{_nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id]}\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Resolve a finished check's specific leaf node id: <paramref name=\"checkName\"/> is looked up\n    /// first against <paramref name=\"task\"/>'s <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>, then its\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> (both sorted ordinal by name, mirroring\n    /// <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c>'s emission order) — so a task-level preflight and a\n    /// guardrail are never confused even if their names happened to collide. Returns null\n    /// (defensive — never set a status for an unrecognized check) when no check matches.\n    /// </summary>\n    private string? ResolveCheckNodeId(TaskNode task, string checkName)\n    {\n        string @base = _nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id];\n\n        int pfIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Preflights, checkName);\n        if (pfIndex >= 0)\n        {\n            return $\"task_{@base}_pf_{pfIndex}\";\n        }\n\n        int grIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Guardrails, checkName);\n        return grIndex >= 0 ? $\"task_{@base}_gr_{grIndex}\" : null;\n    }\n\n    private static int IndexOfByName(IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks, string name)\n    {\n        List<GuardrailDefinition> sorted = checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.Count; i++)\n        {\n            if (string.Equals(sorted[i].Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            {\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Map a finished task's outcome to one of the diagram's three settled status words — the\n    /// live/pending words (\"running\"/\"pending\") never apply here since the task has already\n    /// finished. <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Succeeded\"/>/<see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Skipped\"/> (resume found\n    /// it already succeeded) both read as \"passed\"; <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman\"/>/\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskOutcome.RateLimited\"/>/<see cref=\"TaskOutcome.Cancelled\"/> (an ambiguous,\n    /// operator-actionable halt) all read as \"needs-human\"; everything else — a genuine action or\n    /// \"Node-id scheme\" ---\n\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AllocateNodeIdBases(IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks)\n    {\n        List<TaskNode> ordered = tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        var bases = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        var taken = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n        foreach (TaskNode task in ordered)\n        {\n            string candidate = Sanitize(task.Id);\n            if (!taken.Add(candidate))\n            {\n                int suffix = 2;\n                string Driven directly\n/// against the decorator with hand-built fixtures (no real Scheduler), asserting on the rendered\n/// <c>diagram.html</c> FILE CONTENTS.\n/// <para>\n/// <b>MINIMAL STUB, deliberate TDD red.</b> <see cref=\"OnTheFlyDiagramObserver\"/>'s actual re-render\n/// (<c>WriteDiagram</c>) always throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> today — every test here\n/// that triggers a render (all but <see cref=\"EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged\"/>)\n/// is RED against that stub and turns GREEN once <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c> lands the real\n/// implementation. Every path used below is rooted under a fresh OS temp directory (never a bare\n/// relative literal), so a stub or real render can never write outside this test's own throwaway\n/// tree — see <see cref=\"TempSite\"/>.\n/// </para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests\n{\n    // === status-map/node-id correctness (RED against the throwing stub) =====================\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void TaskStarting_RerendersDiagramWithTheTaskMarkedRunning()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode task = temp.Task(\"01-root\");\n        var observer = temp.Observer(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(task);\n\n        string html = temp.ReadDiagram();\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_root\\\":\\\"running\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void GuardrailFinished_RerendersDiagramWithThatChecksSettledStatus()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode task = temp.Task(\"01-root\", guardrailNames: [\"01-alpha\", \"02-beta\"]);\n        var observer = temp.Observer(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(task);\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"01-alpha\", Passed = true });\n\n        string afterFirst = temp.ReadDiagram();\n        // Only the check that finished flips — the container (still running) and the OTHER,\n        // not-yet-finished check must be unaffected by this specific event.\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_root_gr_0\\\":\\\"passed\\\"\", afterFirst, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_root\\\":\\\"running\\\"\", afterFirst, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"task_01_root_gr_1\", afterFirst, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        observer.GuardrailFinished(task, new GuardrailResult { Name = \"02-beta\", Passed = false });\n\n        string afterSecond = temp.ReadDiagram();\n        // The second check's OWN failure must not retroactively touch the first check's status.\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_root_gr_0\\\":\\\"passed\\\"\", afterSecond, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_root_gr_1\\\":\\\"failed\\\"\", afterSecond, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.Succeeded, \"passed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.GuardrailFailed, \"failed\")]\n    [InlineData(TaskOutcome.NeedsHuman, \"needs-human\")]\n    public void TaskFinished_RerendersDiagramWithTheTasksSettledStatus(TaskOutcome outcome, string expectedStatus)\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode task = temp.Task(\"01-root\");\n        var observer = temp.Observer(IRunObserver.Null, [task]);\n\n        observer.TaskStarting(task);\n        observer.TaskFinished(new TaskResult { TaskId = task.Id, Outcome = outcome, Summary = \"done\" });\n\n        string html = temp.ReadDiagram();\n        Assert.Contains($\"\\\"task_01_root\\\":\\\"{expectedStatus}\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === pass-through (the one test expected to PASS against the stub) ======================\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode task = temp.Task(\"01-root\");\n        var inner = new RecordingObserver();\n        var observer = temp.Observer(inner, [task]);\n\n        observer.AttemptStarting(task, attempt: 2, budget: 3);\n        observer.PlanHashMismatch(\"sha256:previous\");\n        observer.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested: 4);\n        var cleanupError = new InvalidOperationException(\"cleanup boom\");\n        observer.CleanupFailed(\"(prune-orphans)\", cleanupError);\n        observer.PromptPaused(task, \"rate limited\", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), pauseCount: 1);\n\n        Assert.Equal(\n            new[]\n            {\n                \"AttemptStarting:01-root:2:3\",\n                \"PlanHashMismatch:sha256:previous\",\n                \"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:4\",\n                \"CleanupFailed:(prune-orphans):cleanup boom\",\n                \"PromptPaused:01-root:rate limited:30:1\",\n            },\n            inner.Events);\n    }\n\n    // === best-effort render failure (RED against the throwing stub) =========================\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void ARenderFailure_IsSwallowed_AndDoesNotThrow()\n    {\n        using var temp = new TempSite();\n        TaskNode task = temp.Task(\"01-root\");\n\n        // A path whose PARENT segment is itself an existing plain FILE (not a directory) is\n        // guaranteed to fail any real write with an IOException (DirectoryNotFoundException is an\n        // IOException subtype) — entirely inside this test's own OS-temp tree, never touching the\n        // repo working directory regardless of the test runner's current directory.\n        string blockerFile = Path.Combine(temp.Dir, \"blocker-file\");\n        File.WriteAllText(blockerFile, \"not a directory\");\n        string invalidDiagramPath = Path.Combine(blockerFile, \"diagram.html\");\n\n        var observer = new OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n            IRunObserver.Null, [task], invalidDiagramPath, temp.MermaidSource, temp.SourceHash, temp.TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        Exception? thrown = Record.Exception(() => observer.TaskStarting(task));\n\n        Assert.Null(thrown);\n    }\n\n    // === fixtures =============================================================================\n\n    /// <summary>Records the identity + key args of every forwarded event so the pass-through is provable.</summary>\n    private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n\n        public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n            Events.Add($\"AttemptStarting:{task.Id}:{attempt}:{budget}\");\n\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n            Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}:{result.Name}\");\n\n        public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PlanHashMismatch:{previousPlanHash}\");\n\n        public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) =>\n            Events.Add($\"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:{requested}\");\n\n        public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) =>\n            Events.Add($\"CleanupFailed:{owner}:{error.Message}\");\n\n        public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PromptPaused:{task.Id}:{reason}:{(int)backoff.TotalSeconds}:{pauseCount}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway plan-shaped directory tree, entirely under the OS temp root, with\n    /// helpers to build fixtures and construct the observer/read its output — mirrors\n    /// <c>OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.TempSite</c>. Every path this class hands out is rooted under\n    /// <see cref=\"Dir\"/>, so no test in this file can ever write outside its own throwaway tree.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-diagram-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string DiagramHtmlPath => Path.Combine(Dir, \"diagram.html\");\n\n        public string MermaidSource { get; } = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_01_root[\\\"01-root\\\"]\\n\";\n\n        public string SourceHash { get; } = \"deadbeef\";\n\n        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets { get; } =\n            new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_root\"] = \"tasks/01-root/\" };\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id, IReadOnlyList<string>? guardrailNames = null)\n        {\n            IReadOnlyList<string> names = guardrailNames ?? [\"01-check\"];\n            return new TaskNode\n            {\n                Id = id,\n                Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n                Description = \"task \" + id,\n                Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n                Guardrails = names\n                    .Select(n => new GuardrailDefinition { Name = n, Path = $\"{n}.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script })\n                    .ToList(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver Observer(IRunObserver inner, IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks) =>\n            new(inner, tasks, DiagramHtmlPath, MermaidSource, SourceHash, TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        public string ReadDiagram() => File.ReadAllText(DiagramHtmlPath);\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6490,"cache_read_input_tokens":197907,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6490},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"da2e2042-c4b6-4ef5-b6ac-18dee996d70e","uuid":"f9fa5b3c-38bb-47bf-9512-d65fe9e34ca3","request_id":"req_011Cco5R2y6BBeEonxk6wL66"}

`src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs` (the new stub file). After this task

### Background

`src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver.cs` is an existing, working decorator
`IRunObserver` — read it in full before starting; the new class mirrors its exact shape.
It wraps a real observer (`_inner`), forwards every `IRunObserver` event to it, and after
forwarding certain events re-renders a live artifact from an in-memory per-task status
map, serialized under one `lock (_gate)` object, with renders wrapped best-effort (a
render failure never flips a task's outcome — see its private `TryRender` helper).

`IRunObserver` (`src/Guardrails.Core/Execution/IRunObserver.cs`) exposes: `TaskStarting`,
`AttemptStarting`, `TaskFinished`, `GuardrailFinished`, `PlanHashMismatch`,
`ParallelismClampedNoProvider`, `CleanupFailed`, `PromptPaused`.

`02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer` (already landed) added a `nodeStatuses`
parameter to `HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(mermaidSource, sourceHash, taskFolderTargets,
nodeStatuses)` — when non-null, it emits the live status overlay + refresh meta tag this
new observer will call into.

### What to build (tests + stubs only — no real implementation)

Create `src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs`, a new `sealed class
OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver` in namespace `Guardrails.Cli.Ui`, mirroring
`OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s shape exactly:

- Constructor takes (at minimum) the inner `IRunObserver` to wrap, the plan's
  `IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks`, the path to write `diagram.html` to, and whatever
  Mermaid-source/hash/task-folder-targets `HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render` needs to
  re-render (thread these through however is cleanest — you may need to read the
  ALREADY-WRITTEN `diagram.html`'s embedded `<script type="text/plain"
  id="graph-source">` / `<script type="application/json" id="task-folder-targets">`
  content back out to get the Mermaid source + targets map for re-rendering, since the
  observer does not have direct access to the `PlanDefinition` the CLI's `graph` command
  used to generate it originally — OR thread those two values in via the constructor;
  pick whichever is simpler and state your choice).
- On `TaskStarting`: flip that task's node status to `"running"` (and its preflight/
  guardrail leaf ids, if you track per-check granularity at this stage — the coarser
  per-task-only version is acceptable for THIS task; per-check granularity can also be
  driven by `GuardrailFinished`, see below), forward to `_inner`, then re-render
  `diagram.html` under the lock (best-effort — swallow a render failure).
- On `GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)`: flip that specific
  check's node id to `"passed"` or `"failed"` per `result`, forward, re-render.
- On `TaskFinished(TaskResult result)`: flip the task's node status to its settled
  outcome (`"passed"` / `"failed"` / `"needs-human"`, mapped from `result.Outcome`),
  forward, re-render.
- Every other `IRunObserver` member: forward to `_inner` unchanged (no status-map
  involvement) — mirror `OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s pass-through members exactly.
- Write the MINIMAL stub: the class and constructor compile with the right shape, but
  the render call can `throw new NotImplementedException()` — this task's job is
  failing tests, not the real implementation.

### Tests to write

In `tests/Guardrails.Integration.Tests/OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests.cs` (xUnit — this
repo's existing framework), construct a real `OnTheFlyDiagramObserver` wrapping a fake/
no-op `IRunObserver`, fire `TaskStarting`/`GuardrailFinished`/`TaskFinished` against it
directly (no real Scheduler needed — this is a focused unit test of the decorator
itself), and assert on the resulting `diagram.html` FILE CONTENTS written to a temp
directory:

- `TaskStarting_RerendersDiagramWithTheTaskMarkedRunning` — after firing
  `TaskStarting`, the written `diagram.html` contains a `"running"` status entry for
  that task's node id.
- `GuardrailFinished_RerendersDiagramWithThatChecksSettledStatus` — a passed vs a
  failed `GuardrailResult` produces `"passed"`/`"failed"` for that check's node id
  specifically (not the whole task).
- `TaskFinished_RerendersDiagramWithTheTasksSettledStatus`.
- `EveryOtherObserverEvent_IsForwardedToInner_Unchanged` — a spy/fake inner observer
  records that each pass-through event was forwarded exactly once with the same
  arguments.
- `ARenderFailure_IsSwallowed_AndDoesNotThrow` — simulate a render failure (e.g. an
  invalid output path) and assert firing an event does not throw (best-effort, mirroring
  `OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s documented behavior).

These must compile and FAIL against the throwing stub — that failure IS the TDD red
`04-implement-diagram-observer` turns green.

function Block([string]$reason) {
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine("BLOCKED by Guardrails worktree-containment hook: $reason")
    exit 2
}

$rootFull = [System.IO.Path]::TrimEndingDirectorySeparator([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($WorktreeRoot))

function Test-Escapes([string]$candidate) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)) { return $false }

    if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($candidate)) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $rootFull $candidate
    }

    $resolved = [System.IO.Path]::TrimEndingDirectorySeparator([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate))

    if ($resolved -ieq $rootFull) { return $false }
    return -not $resolved.StartsWith($rootFull + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Resolve-AndCheck([string]$candidate) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)) { return }
    if (Test-Escapes $candidate) {
        Block "path '$candidate' resolves outside the task worktree '$rootFull'"
    }
}

        if ($null -eq $cmd) { $cmd = '' }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)git\s+stash(\s|$)') {
            Block "'git stash' is repo-wide, not worktree-scoped -- a concurrent task's stash can silently cross-contaminate this worktree. Use: git diff > TEMP/mine.patch then git checkout -- <files> to test baseline, then git apply TEMP/mine.patch to restore."
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)git\s+worktree\s+add\s') {
            $rest = ($cmd -replace '.*git\s+worktree\s+add\s+', '')
            $tokens = $rest -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
            $i = 0
            $wtPath = $null
            while ($i -lt $tokens.Count) {
                $t = $tokens[$i]
                if ($t.StartsWith('-')) {
                    if ($t -eq '-b' -or $t -eq '-B') { $i++ }
                    $i++
                    continue
                }
                $wtPath = $t
                break
            }
            Resolve-AndCheck $wtPath
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)git\s+checkout\s.*--\s+(?<rest>.+)$') {
            $rest = $Matches['rest']
            foreach ($p in ($rest -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })) {
                Resolve-AndCheck $p
            }
        }

        $redirMatches = [regex]::Matches($cmd, '>>?\s*([^\s&|;]+)')
        if ($redirMatches.Count -gt 0) {
            Resolve-AndCheck $redirMatches[$redirMatches.Count - 1].Groups[1].Value
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)tee\s+(-a\s+)?(?<p>[^\s&|;]+)') {
            Resolve-AndCheck $Matches['p']
        }

        if ($cmd -match '(^|[;&|]|\s)(cp|mv)\s+(?<args>.+)$') {
            $cpArgs = $Matches['args'] -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
            if ($cpArgs.Count -gt 0) {
                Resolve-AndCheck $cpArgs[$cpArgs.Count - 1]
            }
        }
    }
}

Clean — only the two in-scope files remain. Summary of what was built and verified:

**`src/Guardrails.Cli/Ui/OnTheFlyDiagramObserver.cs`** — a new `IRunObserver` decorator mirroring `OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver`'s shape: `TaskStarting` flips the task's container node to `"running"`, `GuardrailFinished` flips only that specific check's leaf node to `"passed"`/`"failed"`, `TaskFinished` flips the container to a settled status (`"passed"`/`"failed"`/`"needs-human"`, mapped from `TaskOutcome`), and every other event is pure pass-through. The Mermaid source/hash/task-folder-targets are threaded via the constructor (design choice documented in the class summary). Node ids reproduce `MermaidRenderer`'s private sanitize+dedupe algorithm locally. The actual re-render (`WriteDiagram`) is a minimal stub throwing `NotImplementedException` — real implementation is `04-implement-diagram-observer`'s job.

**`tests/Guardrails.Integration.Tests/OnTheFlyDiagramObserverTests.cs`** — 7 test cases (including a 3-case theory) firing events at the decorator directly and asserting on `diagram.html`'s file contents, all rooted under a fresh OS temp directory.

**Root cause of the prior two failures, fixed this attempt:** an unrelated pre-existing test (`RetrySalvageTests.cs`, via `$env:GUARDRAILS_WORKSPACE`) writes `outside.txt`/`src/output.txt` as a side effect when the full suite runs inside a live guardrails-managed worktree — those untracked artifacts aren't part of this task's deliverable, so I deleted them after verification, leaving the diff scoped to exactly the two intended files.

Verified: `dotnet build -c Release` clean (0/0); new test class shows 6 red (`NotImplementedException` from the stub, as intended) + 1 green (pure pass-through); full Core suite 744/746 (2 pre-existing unrelated reds from the already-landed search-box stub); full Integration suite 429/437 (6 mine + 1 pre-existing unrelated red from task 05's wiring test, 1 skipped). No state fragment needed per the task contract.
